[시놉시스]&#13;\n&#13;\n아름답고 평화로운 바닷속 왕국에는 여.en:
[Synopsis]

There were six mermaid princesses in a beautiful and peaceful underwater kingdom.
The youngest princess, the most beautiful of them all, turned fifteen and was able to see the world of land.
The little mermaid falls in love with the prince, a man of the land, and wants to become a man, so she goes to see the sea witch.
The witch asks for the mermaid's beautiful voice as a condition.
Moreover, it is said that if the love with the person you love is not fulfilled, it will become a bubble and disappear forever.

[剧情简介]

美丽宁静的水下王国里住着六位人鱼公主。
最年轻的公主，也是所有公主中最美丽的公主，已经十五岁了，能够看到陆地的世界了。
小人鱼爱上了陆地上的王子，并想成为一个男人，于是她去见海女巫。
女巫以美人鱼美丽的声音为条件。
而且，有人说，与所爱的人的爱情如果没有圆满，就会变成泡沫，永远消失。
但小美人鱼为了爱情决定变成人类……
小美人鱼美丽又令人心碎的爱情故事。小美人鱼能幸福吗？

[공연소개]&#13;\n&#13;\n한국이 만들고 세계가 극찬한 공연 N.en:
[Performance introduction]

NANTA, a performance created by Korea and highly praised by the world, since 1997

Nanta is a comical depiction of what happens in the kitchen, based on the rhythm of Samulnori, a traditional Korean melody. 
It is Korea's first non-verbal performance.
Kitchen utensils such as knives and cutting boards are sublimated into wonderful musical instruments, creating a spectacular performance, a surprise traditional wedding, and a performance with the audience. 
With dumpling stacking, traditional Korean dance and samgomu harmonizing with the melody, and drumming with a refreshing ending that will make your heart flutter, etc. 
'Nanta' is a powerful performance that can relieve stress in a fun way for people of all ages and genders, regardless of nationality.
[공연소개]&#13;\n&#13;\n한국이 만들고 세계가 극찬한 공연 N.zh:
【性能介绍】

乱打，自1997年以来韩国独创并受到世界高度评价的表演

《乱打》以韩国传统旋律《四物诺》的节奏为基础，以滑稽的方式描绘了厨房里发生的事情。 
这是韩国首次无语言表演。
刀、菜板等厨房用具升华为美妙的乐器，打造出一场精彩的表演、一场惊喜的传统婚礼、与观众一起表演。 
包饺子、韩国传统舞蹈、三鼓舞等与旋律相呼应的表演，还有令人心旷神怡的击鼓等。 
“乱打”是一种强大的表演，可以以有趣的方式缓解压力，适合所有年龄和性别的人，无论国籍。

[시놉시스]\n\n'그날, 집에 초대받은 순간부터 모든 것이 달라졌다.'.en:
[Synopsis]

'From the moment I was invited to the house that day, everything changed.'

Korean town in Chiang Mai, Thailand in the 1980s.

Recently, there have been scary rumors going around in the village about epidemics and disappearances. 

People who came to visit the house where Korean residents 'Kuntai', his wife 'Vera', and daughter 'Popo' live, each for different reasons.

In this seemingly peaceful house, incomprehensible things and unspeakable secrets are slowly revealed...

An irreversible dinner begins with those invited and those not invited to this house.
[시놉시스]\n\n'그날, 집에 초대받은 순간부터 모든 것이 달라졌다.'.zh:
[剧情简介]

“从那天我被邀请到家里的那一刻起，一切都改变了。”

20 世纪 80 年代泰国清迈的韩国小镇。

最近，村里流传着关于流行病和失踪的可怕谣言。 

来到韩国居民“昆泰”、他的妻子“维拉”和女儿“波波”居住的房子的人们，各自出于不同的原因。

在这座看似平静的屋子里，不可理解的事情、不可言说的秘密慢慢被揭开……

一场不可逆转的晚宴从受邀和未受邀来到这所房子的人开始。

[공연소개]\n\n2026년 매주 월요일,\n대학로 성균소극장에서 펼쳐지.en:
[Performance introduction]

Every Monday in 2026,
Held at Sungkyun Small Theater in Daehakro
Lee Cheol-jin’s story of Seungmu, “Only Seungmu”.


Seungmu (僧舞) is a work of art that represents Korean traditional dance and is a highly aesthetic dance that captures both the spirituality of Buddhist practice and human inner emotions. Jang Sam's delicate lines, controlled breathing and rhythm, and aesthetics of still movement create a world of vitality and deep thought that explodes in silence.

 
This stage is a Seungmu dance presented through an in-depth interpretation by Lee Cheol-jin, a dancer who continues the orthodox lineage that runs from Han Seong-jun, Han Young-sook, and Lee Ae-ju. Having walked a single path as a Buddhist monk for decades, he fully displays the philosophy of dance and the density of time on the stage. In each movement and breath, the accumulated traces of practice and the artist's skills are clearly revealed.

 
〈Only Seungmu〉, which is held as an open run, provides a special time for the audience to face their own inner self through the echo of movement that resonates in silence.
[공연소개]\n\n2026년 매주 월요일,\n대학로 성균소극장에서 펼쳐지.zh:
【性能介绍】

2026年的每周一，
在大学路成均小剧场举行
李哲镇的胜武故事《只有胜武》。


僧舞是代表韩国传统舞蹈的艺术作品，是一种高度审美的舞蹈，捕捉了佛教修行的灵性和人类内心的情感。张三细腻的线条、控制的呼吸和节奏、以及静止的运动美学，创造了一个在寂静中爆发的充满活力和深邃思想的世界。

 
本次舞台是继承了韩成俊、韩英淑、李爱珠正统血统的舞者李哲镇深入演绎的升舞舞。几十年来一直走着佛教僧人之路的他，在舞台上充分展现了舞蹈的哲学和时间的密度。每一个动作、每一个呼吸，都清晰地显现出练习积累的痕迹和艺术家的技巧。

 
以公开赛形式举办的《Only Seungmu》，通过在寂静中产生共鸣的运动的回声，为观众提供了一个面对自己内心的特殊时间。

[공연소개]\n미운 오리 새끼는 단순히 못생긴 오리가 예뻐지는 이야기가.en:
[Performance introduction]
The Ugly Duckling is not simply a story about an ugly duckling becoming pretty.
This work is the first thing children encounter as they grow up.
This is a story that warmly expresses feelings of difference, comparison, and alienation.

A duckling was born different from others.
Being teased and ignored for no reason
You deny your own existence.
But the ugly duckling doesn't give up on himself until the end.
We take one step at a time towards an unfamiliar world.

Even in lonely and difficult times
The ugly duckling who never lost faith in himself
You will finally discover your own identity and value.
And through this process, children
The message that being different from others does not mean you are wrong.
You experience it naturally.

The Ugly Duckling Musical
Music and movement tailored to children’s eye level,
Through an easy-to-understand story structure
This is an educational musical that instills seeds of empathy and self-esteem.
[공연소개]\n미운 오리 새끼는 단순히 못생긴 오리가 예뻐지는 이야기가.zh:
【性能介绍】
《丑小鸭》不仅仅是一个丑小鸭变漂亮的故事。
这项工作是孩子们成长过程中遇到的第一件事。
这是一个热烈表达差异、比较和疏离感的故事。

一只小鸭子出生时就与其他鸭子不同。
无缘无故地被嘲笑和忽视
你否认自己的存在。
但丑小鸭直到最后都没有放弃自己。
我们一步一步走向陌生的世界。

即使在孤独和困难的时期
从未对自己失去信心的丑小鸭
你最终会发现自己的身份和价值。
而通过这个过程，孩子们
与他人不同并不意味着你是错的。
你自然会体验到它。

音乐剧《丑小鸭》
适合儿童视线水平的音乐和动作，
通过易于理解的故事结构
这是一部灌输同理心和自尊种子的教育音乐剧。

[공연소개]\n'비워진 자리, 남겨진 온기'\n\n<슬픈연극>은 이별을.en:
[Performance introduction]
‘Empty space, warmth left behind’

<Sad Play> is the story of an ordinary evening of a couple about to break up. 
There are no special events or dramatic twists. 
Just the words we always said... the place we always sat... the cup of tea we always drank. 
But in that ordinariness 
There are quietly piled up feelings in our hearts that we haven't yet spoken about. 

This play
'It makes me laugh and then makes me cry quietly... 
It's a story that makes you cry and then laugh again.

After the show, the first thing you'll probably do is...
‘It will remind you of the face of the person next to you right now.’ 

Attractiveness of the work> ‘A play that is sad but warm and quiet but remains long-lasting’

*Does not forcefully stimulate the tear glands.
*Stories that remind you of couples, lovers, and parents
*We touch your heart calmly and without exaggerated emotions.
*A play in which ‘silence’ lingers longer than dialogue
*Deep lingering effects whether seen alone or together
[공연소개]\n'비워진 자리, 남겨진 온기'\n\n<슬픈연극>은 이별을.zh:
【性能介绍】
“空荡荡的空间，留下了温暖”

《悲伤剧》讲述了一对即将分手的情侣在一个平凡的夜晚发生的故事。 
没有什么特别的事件或戏剧性的转折。 
只是我们总是说的话...我们总是坐的地方...我们总是喝的一杯茶。 
但就在这平凡之中 
我们的心里，悄悄堆积着一些尚未说出口的感情。 

这部剧
“它让我大笑，然后又让我默默哭泣...... 
这是一个让你哭了然后又笑的故事。

演出结束后，你要做的第一件事可能是……
“它会让你想起你旁边那个人的脸。” 

作品魅力>“一部悲伤却又温暖、安静却历久不衰的剧”

[공연소개] \n\n우리 아이를 위한 클래식 공연 '움라우트 뮤직 키즈.en:
[Performance introduction] 

We invite you to ‘Umlaut Music Kids Classic’, a classical performance for your children!

<What is ‘Umlaut Music Kids Classic’? >
This is a classical performance for infants (preschoolers) and their families starting from the age of 0, when they are too young to go to a concert hall.
This is a performance where children can see, hear with their own ears, and feel with their bodies the vivid classical music played at the concert hall.

< My child experiences this! >
- Helps brain development by using various senses!
- Children improve concentration and become emotionally stable while listening to classical music!
- Your creativity and imagination grow as you experience various sounds!
- Have a great time immersing yourself in the music by following the rhythm and singing along to exciting children's songs and classical songs!

< What instruments do you experience? >
- Touch actual instruments such as violin, cello, and cello with the player and ask, ‘What does this sound like?’ There is time for children to make sounds themselves!

< Parents can enjoy it too! >
As children and parents experience music together, communication and bonding between family members will naturally deepen, right? This is a time when parents who are exhausted from raising children can also heal for a while with music.
[공연소개] \n\n우리 아이를 위한 클래식 공연 '움라우트 뮤직 키즈.zh:
【性能介绍】 

我们邀请您观看“Umlaut Music Kids Classic”，这是为您的孩子准备的古典表演！

<什么是“元音变音儿童经典音乐”？ >
这是为婴儿（学龄前儿童）及其家人从0岁开始的经典表演，那时他们还太小，还不能去音乐厅。
这是一场孩子们可以亲眼看到、亲耳听到、用身体感受音乐厅演奏的生动的古典音乐的表演。

< 我的孩子经历过这个！ >
- 利用各种感官帮助大脑发育！
- 孩子在听古典音乐的同时提高注意力，情绪稳定！
- 当你体验各种声音时，你的创造力和想象力会不断增长！
- 跟随节奏，唱着激动人心的儿歌和古典歌曲，享受沉浸在音乐中的美好时光！

< 您体验过哪些乐器？ >
- 用演奏者触摸小提琴、大提琴、大提琴等实际乐器，并询问“这听起来像什么？”孩子们有时间自己发出声音！

< 家长们也可以享受！ >
当孩子和父母一起体验音乐时，家庭成员之间的沟通和联系自然会加深，不是吗？这个时候，养育孩子疲惫不堪的父母也可以用音乐来治愈一段时间。
[공연소개] \n\n우리 아이를 위한 클래식 공연 '움라우트 뮤직 키즈.ja:
【公演紹介】 

私たちの子供のためのクラシック公演「ウムラウトミュージックキッズクラシック」に招待します！

< 'ウムラウトミュージックキッズクラシック'は何ですか？ >
まだ公演会場に行くには幼い満0歳から幼児（未就学児）と家族のためのクラシック公演です。
会場で演奏される鮮やかなクラシック音楽を私たちの子供たちが直接目で見て、耳で聞いて、体で感じることができる公演です。

<私たちの子供がこんなことを経験します！ >
- いろいろな感覚を使って脳の発達に役立ちます！
- 子供たちがクラシック音楽を聴きながら集中力を育てて情緒安定になりますよ！
- 様々な音を体験しながら創造力と想像力もよもぎ育ちます！
- 楽しい童謡とクラシック曲に合わせてリズムに乗り、一緒に歌いながら音楽の中にすっぽり抜ける時間を持つそうです！

<どの楽器を体験していますか？ >
- ヴァイオリン、チェロ、チェロ本物の楽器に演奏者と触れてみて、「これはどんな音がするの？」子供が直接音を出す時間が用意されています！

<両親も一緒に楽しんでください！ >
子供と両親が一緒に音楽を体験しながら、家族間のコミュニケーションと絆も自然に深くなるでしょう。子育てで疲れた両親もしばらく音楽で癒せる時間です。

[공연소개]\n\n2026 전북국제재즈페스타 시즌 1\n\nDAY 1).en:
[Performance introduction]

2026 Jeonbuk International Jazz Festa Season 1

DAY 1) Stella Cole

'A private gift-like concert where you can meet Stellar Cole, the star with 1.5 million followers who is attracting attention from all over the world, from a distance where you can even hear her breathing!'

<Unrivaled presence that captivated 850,000 people on TikTok and 730,000 people on Instagram>
<Judy Garland, revival of classical elegance reminiscent of Edith Piaf>
<The most notable jazz vocalist of 2026 selected by the legendary Decca>

Feel her delicate vocal control, bright energy, and positive energy conveyed through eye contact, which cannot be felt in a large concert hall, right under your nose. The romance of Old Hollywood, where time seems to have stopped, unfolds right next to you. Stella Cole's first performance in Korea, with a magical voice that makes you feel like you've turned back time! Don't miss the special opportunity to see it right before your eyes at Jeonju The Vine Hall!


DAY 2) Paul Cornish 

‘A young virtuoso chosen by Blue Note, the mecca of jazz!’
'The pinnacle of the current generation's jazz, Paul Cornish, the key pianist of the Joshua Redman Band, visits Korea for the first time!'

<The dream of jazz musicians, a new virtuoso ambitiously presented by ‘Blue Note’ in 2025>
<거장 조슈아 레드맨이 자신의 밴드 피아니스트로 낙점한 독보적인 재능>
<Composition of elite members of the New York jazz scene, including Joshua Crumbly (Bass) and Jonathan Pinson (Drums)>
<Overwhelming techniques ranging from the nostalgia of legendary bebop to the modern sensibility of Robert Glasper>

Witness the hottest sounds of New York, the center of world jazz, right before your eyes at The Vine Hall!
[공연소개]\n\n2026 전북국제재즈페스타 시즌 1\n\nDAY 1).zh:
【性能介绍】

2026 全北国际爵士音乐节第一季

第一天）斯特拉·科尔

“一场私人礼物般的音乐会，您可以在远处甚至可以听到她的呼吸声的情况下见到拥有 150 万粉丝、吸引全世界关注的明星 Stellar Cole！”

<无与伦比的存在感吸引了 TikTok 上的 850,000 名用户和 Instagram 上的 730,000 名用户>
<朱迪·嘉兰，古典优雅的复兴，让人想起伊迪丝·琵雅芙>
<传奇人物Decca选出的2026年最著名的爵士歌手>

感受她细腻的声音控制、明亮的能量以及通过眼神交流传达的正能量，这是在大型音乐厅中感受不到的，就在你的眼皮底下。时间仿佛静止的老好莱坞的浪漫就在您身边展开。 Stella Cole韩国首秀，魔性嗓音让你感觉时光倒流！不要错过在全州 The Vine Hall 亲眼目睹它的特别机会！


第二天）保罗·考尼什 

“爵士乐圣地 Blue Note 选出的一位年轻演奏家！”
“当代爵士乐的顶峰，约书亚·雷德曼乐队的首席钢琴家保罗·考尼什首次访问韩国！”

<爵士音乐家的梦想，2025年‘Blue Note’雄心勃勃呈现的新大师>
<被大师约书亚·雷德曼选为乐队钢琴家的独特才华>
<纽约爵士乐界的精英成员组成，包括Joshua Crumbly（贝斯手）和Jonathan Pinson（鼓手）>
<从传奇比波普的怀旧到罗伯特·格拉斯珀的现代感性，压倒性的技巧>

在 The Vine Hall 亲眼目睹世界爵士乐中心纽约最热门的声音！
[공연소개]\n\n2026 전북국제재즈페스타 시즌 1\n\nDAY 1).ja:
【公演紹介】

2026全北国際ジャズフェスタシーズン1

DAY 1) ステラ・コール

「全世界が注目する150万フォロワーの主人公、「ステラコール」を息吹まで聞こえる街で出会えるプライベートなプレゼントのようなコンサート！」

<チックトック85万、インスタグラム73万人を捕らえた独歩的な存在感>
＜ジュディ・ガランド、エディット・ピアフを連想させるクラシカルな優雅さの復活＞
＜伝説的な「デカレコード（Decca）」が選んだ2026年最も注目されるジャズボーカル

大きな会場では感じられない彼女の繊細なボーカルコントロールと明るいエネルギー、そして目を合わせながら伝える肯定のオーラを鼻の前で直接感じてみてください。時間が止まったような古いハリウッドのロマンスがあなたのそばで広がります。時間を戻したような魔法のような音色、ステラコールの初来韓公演！目の前で見ることができる全州ダバインホールでの特別な機会をお見逃しなく！


DAY 2) ポール・コーニッシュ 

「ジャズの聖地ブルーノートが選んだ若い巨匠！」
「現世代ジャズの頂点、ジョシュアレッドマンバンドのコアピアニストポールコニッシュ初来韓！」

<ジャズミュージシャンたちの夢、「ブルーノート」が2025年野心的に披露した新鋭巨匠>
＜巨匠ジョシュア・レッドマンが自身のバンドピアニストとして落ち着いた独歩的な才能＞
<ジョシュア・クランブリー(Bass)、ジョナサン・フィンソン(Drums)などニューヨーク・ジャズ神のチェ・ジョンエメンバー構成>
＜伝説的なビバップの香水からロバートグラスパーのモダンな感覚まで合わせる圧倒的なテクニック＞

世界ジャズの中心、ニューヨークの最も熱いサウンドをすぐ目の前で、ダバインホールで目撃してください！

[시놉시스]\n\n01 Living Machines, Mechanical.en:
[Synopsis]

01 Living Machines, Mechanical Life
Living machines, mechanical life: Machines indulge in self-destructive mechanical pleasure through movements that can be repeated infinitely while in operation, and human mortality sometimes causes us to fall into the inhuman power of machines. It suggests the possibility of new life forms through the process where life forms and machines indulge and merge with each other.

02 The Intensity of Fusion
Mechanization of unstoppable impulse: The human brain and nerves have an instinctive impulse to survive, but the mechanical instinct is nothing more than simple repetition. When humans give up their nature and accept mechanical impulses,
It reminds us of the moment when metal and flesh become more deeply intertwined, and makes us imagine the possibility of a new life form being born between humans and non-living things.

03 The Mechanization of Irresistible Impulses
Violence of fusion: The moment when machines and living things collide, lusting after each other, iron and flesh, nerves and metal collide roughly. Sensation and insensibility, life and inanimateness mix together, and the possibility of a new existence arises.
This fusion is not a simple union, but a field of creation where neural explosion and mechanical pressure intersect.
At the moment when metal and skin share lustful friction, the boundary between humans and machines becomes blurred, and a new being called 'pseudo-life' exhales like a herald of birth.

04 The Birth of Artificial Life
Birth of similar life: We are aware of the new life forms or side effects that are born.
Will they live in harmony? Machines with a human scent and humans.
It suggests how we should live in the future.
[시놉시스]\n\n01 Living Machines, Mechanical.zh:
[剧情简介]

01 生命机器，机械生命
有生命的机器，机械生命：机器通过在运行中无限重复的运动沉迷于自我毁灭的机械快感，而人类的死亡有时会让我们陷入机器非人的力量之中。它通过生命体与机器的相互沉溺、融合的过程，暗示了新生命体的可能性。

02 融合的强度
不可阻挡的机械化冲动：人的大脑和神经有一种求生的本能冲动，但机械本能无非是简单的重复。当人类放弃本性，接受机械冲动时，
它让我们回想起金属与肉体更加深入交织的那一刻，让我们想象人类与非生物之间诞生新生命形式的可能性。

03 不可抗拒的冲动的机械化
融合暴力：机器与生物碰撞、相互贪婪、钢铁与肉体、神经与金属粗暴碰撞的瞬间。感觉与麻木、生命与无生命混合在一起，一种新存在的可能性出现了。
这种融合不是简单的结合，而是神经爆炸与机械压力交叉的创造场。
当金属与皮肤肆意摩擦的那一刻，人类与机器的界限变得模糊，一种被称为“伪生命”的新存在如诞生的先驱般呼啸而出。

04 人工生命的诞生
类似生命的诞生：我们意识到新生命形式的诞生或副作用。
他们会和睦相处吗？具有人类气味和人类的机器。
它告诉我们未来应该如何生活。

[シノプシス]

01 Living Machines, Mechanical Life
生きている機械、機械的な生命：機械は運転中に無限に繰り返すことができる動きを通して自滅的な機械的快楽に陥り、人間の必死性は時々機械の非人間的な動力に陥ります。生命体と機械が互いに常習し融合する過程を通じて新しい生命体の可能性を示唆する。

02 The Intensity of Fusion
停止できない衝動の機械化：人間の脳と神経は本能的に生き残ろうとする衝動を持っているが、機械的本能は単なる反復に過ぎない。人間が自分の性質を放棄し、機械的衝動を受け入れると、
金属と肉がより深く絡み合う瞬間が連想され、人間と非生物の間で新しい生命体が誕生する可能性を想像させる。

03 The Mechanization of Irresistible Impulses
融合の激しさ：機械と生命体がお互いを常習して衝突する瞬間、鉄と肉、神経と金属が粗く突き当たる。感覚と無感覚、生命と無生命が混ざり合い、新しい存在の可能性が咲きます。
この融合は単なる結合ではなく、神経爆発と機械的圧力が交差する生成の場です。
金属と肌が欲望の若い摩擦を分けるその瞬間、人間と機械の境界はぼやけ、「類似生命」と呼ばれる新たな存在が誕生の予告のように息を吐いた。

04 The Birth of Artificial Life
類似生命の誕生：誕生した新しい生命体や副作用を私たちは
和合して過ごすか、人間の匂いがする機械そして人間。
将来の私たちが生きるべき方法を提示します。

[공연소개]\n2023 국립정동극장 ‘세실 창작ing’ 선정‧개발 / 2.en:
[Performance introduction]
2023 National Jeongdong Theater ‘Cesil Creation’ selected and developed / 2024 ‘Seoul Art Market’ PAMS Choice selection.

Bestseller with cumulative sales of 700,000 copies, winner of the grand prize at the 21st Munhakdongne Children's Literature Award 
Author Ruri’s fairy tale “Long Long Night” is reborn as pansori! 

A deep message is contained within a light narrative. 
This work presents a new form of stage that combines pansori and theater through the development of sensuous music and rhythm. 
Go Soo’s music adds to the story led by the intersection of singers and actors. 
The other side of the work is depicted in more colorful colors.​
[공연소개]\n2023 국립정동극장 ‘세실 창작ing’ 선정‧개발 / 2.zh:
【性能介绍】
2023年国立贞洞剧场“Cesil Creation”评选开发/2024年“首尔艺术市场”PAMS Choice评选。

累计销量70万册畅销书、第21届文鹤童儿童文学奖大奖获得者 
作者瑠璃的童话《长长的夜》重生为板索里！ 

轻松的叙述中蕴藏着深刻的信息。 
这部作品通过感性的音乐和节奏的发展，呈现了一种将板索里和戏剧相结合的新舞台形式。 
高洙的音乐为歌手和演员的交叉故事增添了色彩。 
作品的另一面则以更加绚丽的色彩描绘。​
[공연소개]\n2023 국립정동극장 ‘세실 창작ing’ 선정‧개발 / 2.ja:
【公演紹介】
2023国立鄭東劇場「セシル創作ing」に選定・開発

販売累積70万部ベストセラー、第21回文学近所の子供が文学賞の対象に輝く 
ルリ作家のおとぎ話「ギンギンナイト」がパンソリで再誕生する！ 

軽い叙事詩の中に濃いメッセージを入れた 
この作品は感覚的な音楽とリズムの展開を通じてパンソリと演劇が結合された新しい形式の舞台を披露する。 
サウンドと俳優が交差し、率いる物語に加わる古典的な音楽は、 
より多彩な色で作品の裏面を描く。

[공연소개]\n이번 공연은 행진곡의 생동감에서 시작해 영화 음악의 감동으.en:
[Performance introduction]
This performance is a colorful stage that begins with the liveliness of the march and continues with the emotion of the movie music.

Opening the performance, First Suite for Band – Alfred Reed delightfully displays the rhythm and vitality of a wind ensemble with a work consisting of marches, rags, and gallops. The following song, Pearl Harbor, quietly depicts human emotions in the midst of war with its lyrical melody.

In the middle part, John Williams in Concert, which contains the musical world of John Williams, is played, presenting the charm of film music that is both grand and touching. Afterwards, Beauty and the Beast delivers a fairytale-like time to the audience with familiar melodies and a warm atmosphere.

Lastly, Moment for Morricone, a compilation of Ennio Morricone's famous songs, is played, ending the performance with a deep resonance.
[공연소개]\n이번 공연은 행진곡의 생동감에서 시작해 영화 음악의 감동으.zh:
【性能介绍】
这场演出是一个丰富多彩的舞台，以热闹的进行曲开始，以电影音乐的情感延续。

演出拉开帷幕的是阿尔弗雷德·里德乐队第一组曲，以进行曲、碎布和奔腾组成的作品，令人愉悦地展现了管乐合奏的节奏和活力。接下来的歌曲《珍珠港》，以抒情的旋律静静地描绘了战争中人类的情感。

中段演奏的《约翰·威廉姆斯音乐会》，蕴含了约翰·威廉姆斯的音乐世界，呈现出大气磅礴、感人至深的电影音乐魅力。随后，《美女与野兽》以熟悉的旋律和温馨的气氛为观众带来了一段童话般的时光。

最后，演奏了埃尼奥·莫里康内名曲精选集《Moment for Morricone》，在引起深刻共鸣的同时结束了演出。
[공연소개]\n이번 공연은 행진곡의 생동감에서 시작해 영화 음악의 감동으.ja:
【公演紹介】
今回の公演は行進曲の鮮やかさから始まり、映画音楽の感動につながる、多彩な色彩の舞台です。

公演の扉を開くFirst Suite for Band – Alfred Reedは、行進、ラグ、ギャロップで構成された作品で、管轄合奏のリズム感と活力を愉快に広げています。続くパールハーバーは叙情的な旋律で戦争の中の人間的な感情を静かに描きます。

中盤にはジョン・ウィリアムズの音楽世界を盛り込んだジョン・ウィリアムズ・イン・コンサートが演奏され、壮大さと感動が共存する映画音楽の魅力を披露します。その後、Beauty and the Beastではおなじみのメロディーと暖かい雰囲気で観客におとぎ話のような時間を伝えます。

最後に、Ennio Morriconeの名曲をまとめたMoment for Morriconeが演奏され、深い余韻と共に公演の幕を下ろします。

[공연소개]\n\n클래식 기타리스트 신주헌\n\n창의적인 아이디어와 감성.en:
[Performance introduction]

Classical guitarist Shin Joo-heon

Classical guitarist Shin Joo-heon, who is praised by both the music industry and the public for his creative ideas and emotional interpretation of works, majored in classical guitar and graduated from the Department of Instrumental Music, College of Music, Seoul National University.

He was recognized for his skills by winning prizes at leading domestic and international guitar competitions, including 1st place at the Korean Music Competition, 1st place at the Overseas Dispatch Competition, 2nd place at the International Music Competition Vienna, 1st place at the France Music Competition Guitar, and 4th place at the Adelaide Guitar Festival. Based on this, he has been invited to perform on major stages such as with orchestras and performances at the Seoul Arts Center, and is continuing his active international activities by giving solo recitals and invited performances in Korea, Tokyo, Japan, and Taichung, Taiwan.

He has collaborated with Seongnam Philharmonic Orchestra, Hanyang University College of Music, and Seoul Haegeum Ensemble, and has been invited as a performer to various festivals and stages to communicate with audiences, including a concert with commentary by Geum Nan-sae, Hyundai Motor Company STAGE

In addition, he served as music director for the IBK Industrial Bank of Korea's Win Class VVIP Concert and as the music general artist for Dokdo LIVE hosted by the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, engaging in activities encompassing planning and performance.

Not limited to classical music, he has also been active in a wide range of popular music and content stages, such as PLAY THE GUITAR, musical performances, Nexon game music concerts, and various album production sessions, establishing himself as a performer who crosses the boundary between classical and popular music.

Recently, he has attempted to harmonize Eastern and Western music by collaborating with a number of Korean traditional music players, including duo activities with haegeum player Noh Eun-ah, and is continuously expanding his musical spectrum.

Meanwhile, his music is widely loved by the general public and music lovers at home and abroad through broadcast appearances such as SBS Amazing Competition Star King, KBS Music Room, and KBS Korean Traditional Music Festival, as well as YouTube and SNS content media.

He is currently teaching at Seoul Arts High School, Gyeonggi Arts High School, and Yewon School, and served as a conductor and music director for guitar ensemble classes at the former Armed Forces Financial Management Corps. In addition, he is striving to nurture younger students by running Shin Joo-heon's guitar class, and was awarded the Korea Guitar Association's Outstanding Leader Award.

In addition, he received the Korea Best Brand Cultural Artist Award in recognition of his musical achievements and contribution to the field of culture and arts.

Continuing his various activities, he is currently attracting attention as a next-generation guitar player, captivating the hearts of audiences with his beautiful tone and technically sophisticated performance.

[공연소개]\n본 공연은 전통 가야금과 25현 가야금으로 아리랑, 산조,.en:
[Performance introduction]
This performance is an interpretive performance that combines Arirang, sanjo, folk songs, and popular melodies with the traditional gayageum and 25-string gayageum. It introduces the depth of traditional music and modern reinterpretation, and proposes an intimate musical experience that communicates with the audience in a salon space.

[PROGRAM]
* Two Arari 
This is a performance piece that newly arranged Jeongseon, Gangwon-do, Haeju, and Jindo Arirang into traditional gayageum and 25-string gayageum. It is a lyrical opening song that conveys the emotion of Korean folk songs through various gayageum tones.

* Kimjukparyu Gayageum Sanjo 
Kim Juk-pa is a master who established the flow of gayageum sanjo in the 20th century. Kimjukparyu Sanjo is a representative piece that shows the artistry and skills of the performer with its delicate Sigimsae, various playing techniques, and gradually faster beats.

* <A Million Roses> 
A Million Roses is widely known as Shim Soo-bong's song in Korea, but it began with the song <The Life of a Girl Given by Marinya>, which was released in Latvia in 1981. It contains a mythological story about the goddess of the earth and fate, Mara, suffering because she forgot to give happiness to her daughter. It was later rewritten into Russian and became widely known as a love song, and today's performance tells the story of how this melody traveled across borders.

* 25-string gayageum <Doraji Taryeong>
This is a performance piece that reinterprets the representative folk song of the Gangwon-Gyeonggi region, <Bolaji Taryeong>, using the wide vocal range and harmony of the 25-string gayageum.

* Memories engraved in my heart - <Cheommilmil> 
The theme song ‘Wolryang Representative Ah Jeoksim’ and ‘I’m Still Loving You’ from the movie <Cheommilmil> are played on two gayageums.
[공연소개]\n본 공연은 전통 가야금과 25현 가야금으로 아리랑, 산조,.zh:
【性能介绍】
本次演出是阿里郎、三条、民歌、流行旋律与传统伽倻琴、25弦伽倻琴相结合的诠释表演。它引入了传统音乐的深度和现代的重新诠释，并提出了在沙龙空间中与观众交流的亲密音乐体验。

[节目]
* 两个阿拉里 
这是将旌善、江原道、海州、珍岛阿里郎重新编入传统伽倻琴和25弦伽倻琴的演奏作品。这是一首抒情的开场曲，通过各种伽倻琴音调传达韩国民歌的情感。

* 金十花伽倻琴三条 
金竹波是20世纪开创伽倻琴三条流的大师。 《金竹花流三条》是一首以细腻的弦乐、多样的演奏技巧和逐渐加快的节奏展现演奏者艺术性和技巧的代表作品。

* <一百万朵玫瑰> 
《一百万朵玫瑰》在韩国以沈秀峰的歌曲而广为人知，但它始于1981年在拉脱维亚发行的歌曲《玛琳娅给予的女孩的生活》。它讲述了大地和命运女神玛拉因忘记给女儿幸福而遭受痛苦的神话故事。后来这首歌被改写成俄语，成为一首广为人知的情歌，今天的演出讲述了这首旋律如何跨越国界的故事。

* 25弦伽倻琴<桔梗打令>
这是利用25弦伽倻琴宽广的音域和和声重新诠释江原京畿地区的代表性民歌《Bolaji Taring》的表演作品。

* 铭刻在心的回忆 - <Cheommil> 
两台伽倻琴演奏了电影<Cheommilmil>的主题曲“月梁代表阿积心”和“我仍然爱着你”。
[공연소개]\n본 공연은 전통 가야금과 25현 가야금으로 아리랑, 산조,.ja:
【公演紹介】
本公演は伝統的なカヤグムと25弦のカヤグムで、アリラン、三条、民謡、大衆的に馴染みのある旋律を結んだ解説型公演である。

[PROGRAM]
* 2台のアラリ 
チョンソン、江原道、ヘジュ、ジンドアリランを伝統歌冶金と25弦歌冶金で新たに編曲した演奏曲で、韓国民謡の情緒を様々なカヤ金音色で伝える叙情的なオープニング曲だ。

*キムジュクパリュウガヤムサンジョ 
キム・ジュクパは20世紀のカヤ金山組の流れを定立した名人だ。キム・ジュクパリュンサンジョは、繊細な詩と様々な主法、徐々に速くなる取り締まりで演奏者の芸術性と技量を見せてくれる代表的な曲だ。

*<百万松バラ> 
百万松薔薇は国内ではシムスボンの歌として広く知られているが、その始まりは1981年ラトビアで発表された歌「マリーニャがくれた少女の人生」だ。大地と運命の女神「マラ」が娘に幸せを与えることを忘れて苦難を経験するという神話的な話を込めている。以後ロシア語で開社され、愛歌として広く知られ、今日演奏はこのメロディが国境を越えて伝えられた旅程を聞かせてくれる。

* 25弦歌冶金<ドラジター領>
江原（カンウォン）京畿地域の代表民謡＜ドラジタ令＞を２５弦歌冶金の広い音域と火星で新たに解き放った演奏曲だ。

*私の心に刻まれた思い出 - <高密度> 
映画「先密ミル」の主題歌「月量代表赤ちゃん心」「I'm StillLovingYou」を2台のカヤグムにまとめて演奏する。

[공연소개]\n\n합창단 음악이있는마을은 ‘한국어의 아름다움을 합창으로.en:
[Performance introduction]

Village with Choir Music was founded in 1996 by the first director, Lee Kang-sook (who served as the first president of Korea National University of Arts), to develop and distribute Korean choral music in the spirit of ‘bringing the beauty of the Korean language to the choir and to the world’ and to grow into a world-class choir. Currently, there are about 60 active musicians and members, including 2nd director Kun-yong Lee (former president of Korea National University of Arts), planning director Seung-chan Hong (arts management, professor at Korea National University of Arts), music director Jun-cheol Hong (former professor at Daewoo, Sungkonghoe University), and conductor Hong-soo Kim (currently professor of conducting department at Korea National University of Arts). We are striving to widely disseminate Korean choral music through a total of 22 regular performances and various collaborative and joint performances, and we plan to present composer Kim Jun-beom's cantata ‘The Missing Case of Samsinhalmae’ and various original choral pieces through the 23rd regular concert.

【性能介绍】

Village with Choir Music于1996年由首任院长李康淑（曾任韩国艺术大学首任校长）创立，本着“将韩语之美带给合唱团和世界”的精神，开发和传播韩国合唱音乐，并成长为世界一流的合唱团。目前，约有60名活跃的音乐家和成员，包括第二任导演李健勇（韩国艺术大学前校长）、企划总监洪升灿（艺术管理、韩国艺术大学教授）、音乐总监洪俊哲（前圣公会大学大宇教授）、指挥金红洙（现任韩国艺术大学指挥系教授）。我们通过总共22场定期演出和各种合作、联合演出，努力广泛传播韩国合唱音乐，并计划通过第23届定期音乐会呈现作曲家金俊范的清唱剧《三神馆失踪案》和各种原创合唱作品。

[공연소개]\n‘스타’라는 개념을 클래식계에 새롭게 각인시킨 두 피아니스.en:
[Performance introduction]
Two pianists who imprinted the concept of ‘star’ in the classical world.
Peter Jablonski and Jeongwon Kim.
Appearance and charisma reminiscent of idols at the time of debut, and matching
Two artists who have charted unrivaled trajectories in their respective paths with their talent and musical depth.
Do you remember your first duo performance at the Seoul Arts Center 15 years ago?
Since then, through continued musical exchanges and friendships, he is on his way to becoming a virtuoso.
The two of them have become more mature in their interpretations and can communicate with just their eyes,
We will tell you a musical conversation that goes beyond a simple collaboration and spans the ages.

Pianists Peter Jablonsky and Jeongwon Kim debuted as star icons of the classical music world representing the 1990s and 2000s, and are performers who have received both deep musicality and wide public love. In this duo recital, Beethoven's Symphony No. 9, one of the most beloved symphonies by the public, will be presented in a special version arranged for two pianos by the ‘piano magician’ Franz Liszt.
In addition, through a colorful and fantastic program created by two pianos and four hands, the delicate sensibilities and excellent chemistry of the two performers are highlighted, and a deep musical conversation that only artists who have walked through the same era can be shared on stage.

퇴직과 이별로 마음의 자리를 잃어버린 ‘민경’은 작은 시골마을로 내려와.en: ‘Min-kyung’, who has lost her place in her heart due to retirement and separation, comes down to a small rural village and begins to spend her time quietly taking pictures. One day, an old man enters her camera, which focuses on landscapes rather than people and distance rather than emotions. ‘Deokgu’, a Vietnam veteran suffering from dementia. After losing his granddaughter in a car accident, his memory is gradually fading. Although he suffers from dementia, he sits in front of his house every morning and waves to his dead granddaughter. At the moment of taking a picture, he looks at the camera with clearer eyes than anyone else. The record that started out as a coincidence gradually becomes ‘Min-kyung’s’ day, and the time spent learning the story of Deok-gu’s family and trying to hold on to Deok-gu’s losing memories soon becomes a time to caress and heal Min-kyung’s own wounds. People who are losing their memories and people who have lost their direction in life. Two people with different wounds regain their smiles through photos and begin to share their feelings little by little. And finally, Deok-gu enters Min-kyung’s heart and says the words that resonate the brightest. “Kim~chi!” Like that one photo, the time between the two becomes clear again.

[공연소개]\n달음의 두 번째 정규 앨범 〈Coexistence〉는 ‘함.en:
[Performance introduction]
Daleum’s second regular album, “Coexistence,” is a musical work that depicts the harmony and balance created by different beings under the theme of ‘living together.’
This performance is centered around the sound of coexistence created by two traditional string instruments, the gayageum and geomungo. The program begins with ‘Dasreum’ based on traditional modes and continues through ‘Tal’, ‘dot’, ‘The Waves’, ‘Cracking’, and ‘Alive’, showing a musical narrative where tradition and modernity intersect. Each song expresses everyday emotions, cracks, recovery, and the energy of life in various ways and is structured so that the audience can comfortably immerse themselves in it. Daleum's unique performance style, which maintains the depth of traditional music while adding a modern sensibility, will provide a new experience to the audience.

[Program]
1. Dasreum

2. Tal

3.dot

4. Dodry

5.The Waves

6. Poison and Antidote

7.In the deep

8. Cracking

9. Alive
[공연소개]\n달음의 두 번째 정규 앨범 〈Coexistence〉는 ‘함.zh:
【性能介绍】
Daleum的第二张正规专辑《Coexistence》是一首音乐作品，描绘了以“共同生活”为主题的不同存在体所创造的和谐与平衡。
这场表演以伽倻琴和巨文琴两种传统弦乐器共存的声音为中心。节目以基于传统调式的《Dasreum》开始，依次为《Tal》、《dot》、《The Waves》、《Cracking》、《Alive》，展现了传统与现代交叉的音乐叙事。每首歌都以不同的方式表达日常的情感、裂缝、恢复和生命的能量，并且结构合理，让听众可以轻松地沉浸其中。戴勒姆独特的演奏风格，保持了传统音乐的深度，同时又增添了现代感性，将为观众带来全新的体验。

[节目内容]
1. 达斯雷姆

2.塔尔

3.点

4.多德里

5.海浪

6. 毒药与解药

7.在深处

8. 开裂

9. 活着
[공연소개]\n달음의 두 번째 정규 앨범 〈Coexistence〉는 ‘함.ja:
【公演紹介】
月音の2番目の正規アルバム「Coexistence」は「一緒に生きていくこと」というテーマの下で、異なる存在が生み出す調和とバランスを音楽的に作った作品だ。
この公演は、2つの伝統弦楽器であるカヤグムとコムンゴが生み出す共存の音を中心に構成される。番組は伝統線法を基盤とした「ダルム」から始まり、「脱」、「dot」、「The Waves」、「Cracking」、「Alive」まで続く流れの中で、伝統と現代が交差する音楽的叙事詩を見せる。各曲は日常の感情、亀裂、回復、生命のエネルギーを多様な結で表現され、観客が快適に没入できるように構成される。伝統音楽の深さを維持しながらも現代的な感覚を加えた甘さだけの演奏方式は観客に新しい経験を提供するだろう。

[プログラム]
1.ダスラム(Dasreum)

2. 脱(Tal)

3. dot

4. ドドリー

5. The Waves

6. Poison and Antidote

7. In the deep

8. Cracking

9. Alive

[시놉시스]\n\n2001년 9월 4일 월요일 오전 7시 39분. 한 소.en:
[Synopsis]

Monday, September 4, 2001, 7:39 AM. The moment a girl takes her steps, time becomes undifferentiated and stops. The girl closes her eyes, sneezes, and floats in the air.
In that moment, a perfect rainbow at an angle of 42 degrees unfolds before your eyes. The seven-color panorama from red to purple is replaced with everyday objects such as trains, sheet music, jackets, and swimsuits, filling the stage. The seven notes of Doremi Fasolassido overlap to create a huge chord, but the girl who is the protagonist of that moment is unaware of this wonderful cosmic phenomenon.
Starting from a sneeze, time flows back and forth. People around me, friendship, dating, learning. The girl looks at the world by breaking it into small pieces, and reaches sadness and resentment within it.
So the girl sneezes, breathing and spitting out all of this with all her might.

[공연소개]\n봄길 위에서 음악이라는 언어로 쓰인, 가장 아름다운 역사책.en:
[Performance introduction]
Opening the most beautiful history book written in the language of music on a spring road
-The confession of the soloist becomes the sound of the choir... A special journey that continues a great legacy -

Bach, Beethoven, Brahms...and Schubert and Schumann.
The music of virtuosos whose names alone make our hearts beat has arrived in Mokpo riding the warm spring breeze.
This performance is a special stage where the beautiful 'German art song' that someone had quietly sung alone blooms again with the delicate harmony created by the Mokpo City Choir.
As we walk through the romantic forest following guest conductor Hwang Ji-hee's friendly commentary, we reach the premiere song 'Mokpo Station', where the music embodies our waiting and excitement. 
At the 'starting point of excitement' rather than the final station, please experience the scenery of the train flying into the sky and the Archipelago Sea becoming a constellation through the chorus.
[공연소개]\n봄길 위에서 음악이라는 언어로 쓰인, 가장 아름다운 역사책.zh:
【性能介绍】
在春天的路上打开用音乐的语言书写的最美的历史书
-独奏者的忏悔变成了合唱团的声音......延续伟大遗产的特殊旅程 -

巴赫、贝多芬、勃拉姆斯……还有舒伯特和舒曼。
光是名字就让人心潮澎湃的大师们的音乐乘着温暖的春风来到了木浦。
这次演出是一个特殊的舞台，由木浦市合唱团创造的微妙和声，让曾经有人静静地独自唱出的优美的“德国艺术歌曲”再次绽放。
伴随着客座指挥黄智熙亲切的解说，我们漫步在浪漫的森林中，到达了首映曲《木浦站》，音乐中充满了我们的等待和兴奋。 
在“兴奋的起点”而不是终点站，请通过合唱体验火车飞向天空和群岛海变成星座的景色。
[공연소개]\n봄길 위에서 음악이라는 언어로 쓰인, 가장 아름다운 역사책.ja:
【公演紹介】
春の道の上で音楽という言語で書かれた、最も美しい歴史本を広げて
-独創の告白が合唱の響きで…偉大な遺産をつなぐ特別な旅-

バッハ、ベートーヴェン、ブラームス…そしてシューベルトとシューマン。
名前だけでも胸を走る巨匠たちの音楽が暖かい春風に乗って木浦に到着しました。
今回の公演は誰か一人で静かに歌っていた美しい「ドイツ芸術歌曲」が、木浦市立合唱団が醸し出す繊細なハーモニーで再び咲く特別な舞台です。
ファン・ジヒ客員指揮者の親切な解説に沿ってロマンの森を歩いてみると、音楽はいつの間にか私たちの待ち時間とときめきを込めた超連曲「木浦駅」に違います。 
終着駅ではなく「ときめきの始点」で、空に飛び立つ列車と星座になった茶道海の風景を合唱で体験してください。

[공연소개]\n2023년 [문턱]의 시작을 알렸던 무대에 김단비밴드 래인.en:
[Performance introduction]
Danbi Kim's band Lane was on stage to announce the start of [Threshold] in 2023.
Since then, the three-year threshold has moved forward with a new breath, and Lane stands at the beginning again.

<New Beginning, Lane> is a starting point for refining their respective meanings for both [Threshold] and Kim Danbi Band Lane.

Based on the experience accumulated so far, [Threshold] further improves the completeness of the performance and expands the scope of the performance by embracing various arts centered on music.

Lane redefines the meaning of the team name from 'Rain', which symbolizes comfort, to 'Rain (來潾)', which symbolizes coming clarity.

Dreaming of a place where clear sound always flows (來潾) and the sound of people visiting (來人) never ceases (來人), this performance shares the excitement and anticipation of the beginning, a little fear, and yet a cheerful heartbeat through music.

Following Kim Dan-bi's in-depth commentary and witty and witty progress, the performance and story naturally continue, and the audience crosses the time of a new beginning while listening to the music.

<New beginning, Lane>.
Sound and people meet again when I stand in front of them for the first time.

[Program]

Prologue - Wooden Child Pinocchio
The fairy who granted the father's wish for a child, “Prove that you are brave, truthful, and unselfish, and one day you will become a real person!”

Chapter 1 Village Market
In a peaceful marketplace, a greedy count tyrannizes the villagers.

Chapter 2 Grandfather returns home
Pinocchio and his grandfather's first meeting.

Chapter 3 The road to school
Pinocchio is different from ordinary children.

Chapter 4 Pinocchio's Lie
Pinocchio bravely jumps into the wandering group... His nose gets longer every time he lies, and it returns to its original state with just a word of 'truth'!

Chapter 5 Pinocchio's wrong choice
Pinocchio did not listen to his father. “You must learn to choose between right and wrong. Your ‘heart’ will give you the answer.”

Chapter 6 Inside the whale's belly...
When I found out about my father's love, I cried because I was worried and sad for my father, who was trapped inside the Pinocchio whale's stomach.

Epilogue - Pinocchio, a real person gained through ‘heart’
Something magical happened to Pinocchio, who found his ‘true heart’!!!

In December 2020, he realizes that his time is running out and begins to record his daily life. Every moment of Ryuichi Sakamoto lived through music until the end.

마티네 콘서트Ⅰ: 김영하 작가의 여행의 이유, 그리고 음악.en: Matinee Concert Ⅰ: Author Youngha Kim’s reason for travel, and music

[공연소개]\n\n수요일 오전, 클래식 음악과 함께 하는 마티네 콘서트..en:
[Performance introduction]

Wednesday morning, a matinee concert with classical music.
We are waiting for four meetings in 2026. In April and May, September and October, we meet between seasons and start talking about music.
This series is co-created by writer Kim Young-ha. Every month, we present new stories and a curation of music hand-selected by the author.

Reason for music, reason for travel
Europe walked through the eyes of a novelist and remembered through the melody of music

Why do we go on a trip?
Best-selling author and storyteller of our time, Kim Young-ha, will become the host of the 2026 Matinee series and invite audiences to a romantic city in Europe.
This series is a high-quality lecture concert that combines classical music with the unfamiliar landscapes and people that the author encountered while traveling to Italy, Germany, France, and Spain, and the humanistic insights he gained there.
The brilliant sunlight, lonely contemplation, and artistic inspiration felt while traveling are vividly brought to the stage.
In a leisurely time in the morning, a combination of author Kim Young-ha's charming conversation and a performance full of local flavor will be a special rest that will remind you of the 'reason for travel' when you are tired of repetitive daily life.

Life is like a festival, the land of opera
In warm April, Italians live like the main characters on stage every day. Eat well, laugh loudly, and love passionately. It follows the cheerful and optimistic lifestyle of Italians as told by author Youngha Kim. It is the most exciting stage to fill the vitality of spring while appreciating gorgeous and dramatic opera arias and romantic Italian songs.

주먹 하나로 학교를 평정한 여고생, 이번엔‘추리닝’입고 돌아왔다! 강한.en: The high school girl who conquered the school with just one fist is back, this time wearing ‘sweatshirts’! ‘Minah’, who has a strong sense of chivalry and determination, is an overly righteous girl who lost her parents in an accident at a young age and grew up at her aunt’s house. Minah entered high school with the promise of ‘never fighting again’ and dreams of a new, ordinary start, but from the first day, she falls in love with her handsome and seemingly just friend ‘Mingi’. The problem is ‘Se-hyuk’, the leader of the delinquent Iljin Circle who is targeting Min-gi. Min-ah, who saw Se-hyuk's gang bullying Min-gi, couldn't bear it anymore and rescued Min-gi 'in a sweatshirt that covered her face'. After this day, the school is in an uproar trying to find the identity of the sweatshirt guy, and Mingi begins a full-fledged investigation to find the savior. Meanwhile, the triangular battle between Min-ah, Hye-ri, and Se-hyeok, with Min-gi in the middle, ignites, and Min-ah hides her identity and leads a triple life, pretending to be normal, mischievous, and in love. But is that possible for Minah, who has an explosive sense of justice and is also hot-tempered? Love becomes twisted, identity is in danger of being revealed, and the fight grows bigger...

브루클린의 배관공에서 세계를 구한 히어로로 레벨업한 형제 ‘마리오’와 ‘.en: Brothers ‘Mario’ and ‘Luigi’, who leveled up from plumbers in Brooklyn to heroes who saved the world, build a special friendship while rescuing ‘Yoshi’ who got lost while carrying out a mission in the Sand Kingdom. Meanwhile, in order to regain the honor of the fallen ‘Koopa’ family, the evil prince ‘Koopa Junior’ kidnaps ‘Roselina’, the guardian of the galaxy and Chicos’ mother, and attacks the kingdom to retrieve their father ‘Kopa’ who was captured by the Mushroom Kingdom. In the midst of another crisis, Mario, Luigi, Peach, Kinopio, and even the newly joined Yoshi save Rosalina and jump into the wide galaxy to stop Koopa Junior's extraordinary plan...

[공연소개]\n\n\n\n미씽 Missing\n\n현대무용 × 인터랙티브.en:
[Performance introduction]



Missing

Contemporary dance × Interactive media art



A record of adaptation, a body that never stops

What record will your body leave in a lost world?



What has disappeared?

Is it nature, air, or senses?

Or is it the human form we knew?



〈Missing〉 observes the human body reorganizing itself in a changed environment. In this work, the body is not the subject of expressing emotions. The body is a structure that responds to the environment and is a constantly adapting system.



What Missing refers to is not simple disappearance. The loss of familiar sensations, the previous way of breathing, the relationship with nature, and some of the forms that defined humans have been erased. However, this work does not mourn that loss. We quietly look at the body that continues to transform and adapt even after it disappears.



[Synopsis]



A body wrapped in wrap is on stage. It is not a sign of oppression, but a condition. In an environment full of dust and toxins, the body surrounds itself and redesigns its functions within limited conditions. Media art is layered on the body, and the body is distorted, transformed, and reborn.



The body faces the floor. Contact with nature and soil that remains among the artifacts. A body that reawakens at the cellular level through the skin, through movement, and through movement. The dancers' movements unfold in space in the form of waves and contours and respond in real time to interactive media.



When the environment changes, the body also changes. Where beauty standards disappear, the body creates a new balance. Physically impossible distortions of the body are visualized through the media, and traces of evolution are revealed in unfamiliar forms on stage.



Nevertheless, humans do not give up on relationships. Pushing and pulling, misaligning and intertwining, the transformed bodies adapt together. The essence of a relationship remains the same even if the environment changes.



The song flows. The body responds to the sound. In places where language cannot reach, the body instinctively moves towards nature. A body that is distorted and changed, but does not give up hope. 〈Missing〉 is not a work of restoring something that has disappeared. It is an exploration of the body that continues to transform and adapt even after it disappears. After this work is over, it is enough for the audience to be aware of their breathing and body for a moment.
[공연소개]\n\n\n\n미씽 Missing\n\n현대무용 × 인터랙티브.zh:
【性能介绍】



失踪

当代舞蹈×互动媒体艺术



适应的记录，永不止步的身体

你的身体会在失落的世界留下什么记录？



什么消失了？

是自然、空气还是感官？

还是我们所知道的人类形态？



《失踪》观察人体在变化的环境中自我重组。在这部作品中，身体并不是表达情感的主体。身体是一个对环境做出反应的结构，是一个不断适应的系统。



所谓的失踪，并不是简单的消失。熟悉的感觉、以前的呼吸方式、与自然的关系以及一些定义人类的形式的丧失都被抹去了。然而，这部作品并没有哀悼这种损失。我们静静地看着身体，即使它消失了，它仍然在继续变化和适应。



[剧情简介]



舞台上有一具裹着布的尸体。这不是压迫的迹象，而是一种状况。在充满灰尘和毒素的环境中，身体围绕着自己，在有限的条件下重新设计自己的功能。媒体艺术层叠在身体上，身体被扭曲、改造和重生。



身体面向地板。与文物中残留的自然和土壤的接触。一个通过皮肤、通过运动、通过运动在细胞水平上重新唤醒的身体。舞者的动作以波浪和轮廓的形式在空间中展开，并实时响应互动媒体。



当环境改变时，身体也会发生改变。在美丽标准消失的地方，身体创造了新的平衡。物理上不可能的身体扭曲通过媒体被可视化，进化的痕迹在舞台上以不熟悉的形式显现出来。



尽管如此，人类并没有放弃人际关系。推拉、错位和缠绕，变形后的身体适应在一起。即使环境发生变化，关系的本质仍然是一样的。



歌声流淌。身体对声音做出反应。在语言无法到达的地方，身体本能地走向自然。身体扭曲、改变，但不放弃希望。 《Missing》并不是恢复已经消失的东西的作品。这是对身体的探索，即使在身体消失后，身体仍会继续转变和适应。这部作品结束后，观众能暂时意识到自己的呼吸和身体就足够了。
[공연소개]\n\n\n\n미씽 Missing\n\n현대무용 × 인터랙티브.ja:
【公演紹介】



ミシン Missing

現代ダンス×インタラクティブメディアアート



適応の記録、止まらない体

失われた世界では、あなたの体はどんな記録を残しますか？



何が消えたのか。

自然なのか、空気なのか、感覚なのか。

それとも私たちが知っていた人間の形なのか。



〈ミシンミッシング〉は変化した環境の中で自らを再組織する人間の体を観察する。この作品では、体は感情を表現する主体ではありません。体は環境に反応する構造であり、常に適応するシステムです。



ミシンが指しているのは単なる消滅ではありません。慣れていた感覚の喪失、以前の呼吸方式、自然との関係、そして人間を規定していた形態の一部が消去された状態。しかし、この作品はその喪失を哀悼しない。消えた後も引き続き変形して適応する体を静かに覗く。



[シノプシス]



ラップで巻かれた体が舞台の上にある。抑圧の表示ではなく、一つの条件だ。ほこりや毒性に満ちた環境の中で、体は自分自身を包み込み、限られた条件で機能を再設計します。その体の上にメディアアートが重なり、体は歪んで変形して生まれ変わります。



体は床に向かう。人工物の間に残っている自然、土との接触。皮膚を通して、動きを通して、細胞ユニットから再び目を覚ます体。ダンサーの動きは、波長と等高線の形で空間上に広がり、インタラクティブメディアとリアルタイムで反応します。



環境が変わると体も変わる。美しさの基準が消えた席で、体は新しいバランスを作り出す。物理的に不可能な身体の歪みはメディアを介して可視化され、進化の兆候はステージの上で見知らぬ形に現れます。



それでも人間は関係をあきらめない。押して引っ張ってずらして編み、変形した体は一緒に適応する。関係の本質は環境が変わってもそのままだ。



曲が流れます。体はその音に反応します。言語が届かないところで、体は本能的に自然に向かって動く。歪んで変化したが希望をあきらめないボディ。 〈ミシン〉は消えたものを復元する作業ではない。消えた後も引き続き変形して適応して生きていく体に対する探求だ。この作品が終わった後、観客がしばらく自分の呼吸と体を意識すればそれで十分だ。

[공연소개]\n도덕과 생존 사이, 여성이 감당해야 했던 선택의 대가\n\.en:
[Performance introduction]
Between morality and survival, the price of choice that women had to bear

We present “Mrs. Warren’s Occupation” by George Bernard Shaw, a Nobel Prize winner in literature and a leading British critic, thinker, and playwright. This work sharply criticized the structural inequality of British society that economically oppresses women through the 'prostitute problem', and caused a great stir when it was published. It also attracts attention in that five-time Olivier Award winner Imelda Staunton plays mother and daughter together for the first time with her own daughter, Bessie Carter. In addition, this work is a new work in which Imelda Staunton and director Dominic Cooke have joined hands once again, and sheds a deep light on human choice and responsibility at the point where morality and self-reliance, tradition and progress collide.

[Plot]
Bibi Warren is an intelligent and independent young woman who has just graduated from college. She learns that her mother, Kitty Warren, used socially unacceptable methods to make a living in the past. Bibi questions whether her mother's choice was morally justifiable, and is conflicted as she faces the reality that it is not a thing of the past. A daughter and a father who try to live according to their beliefs

The mother's values, which had to survive in a wealthy society, clash. But what was the price of Mrs. Warren's enormous wealth?
[공연소개]\n도덕과 생존 사이, 여성이 감당해야 했던 선택의 대가\n\.zh:
【性能介绍】
道德与生存之间，女性不得不承受的选择代价

我们推出诺贝尔文学奖获得者、英国著名批评家、思想家和剧作家萧伯纳的《沃伦夫人的职业》。这部作品尖锐批评了英国社会通过“妓女问题”在经济上压迫女性的结构性不平等，出版后引起了巨大轰动。此外，五届奥利弗奖得主伊梅尔达·斯汤顿 (Imelda Staunton) 首次与自己的女儿贝西·卡特 (Bessie Carter) 一起扮演母女，这一点也引起了人们的关注。此外，本作是伊梅尔达·斯汤顿与导演多米尼克·库克再次携手的新作，深刻揭示了道德与自力更生、传统与进步碰撞时人类的选择与责任。

[剧情]
比比·沃伦是一位聪明、独立的年轻女性，刚刚大学毕业。她得知她的母亲基蒂·沃伦过去曾使用社会不可接受的方式谋生。比比质疑她母亲的选择在道德上是否合理，并且当她面对这已不再是过去的现实时，她很矛盾。女儿和父亲努力按照自己的信仰生活

母亲的价值观必须在富裕社会中生存，但两者之间发生了冲突。但沃伦夫人的巨额财富的代价是什么呢？
[공연소개]\n도덕과 생존 사이, 여성이 감당해야 했던 선택의 대가\n\.ja:
【公演紹介】
道徳と生存の間、女性が余裕がなければならなかった選択の代価

ノーベル文学賞受賞者であり、イギリスの代表的な批評家、思想家、劇作家であるジョージ・バーナード・ショーの「ウォーレン夫人の職業」を披露する。この作品は「売春婦問題」を通じて女性を経済的に抑圧する英国社会の構造的不平等を鋭く批判し、発表当時大きな反響を起こした。オリビエ賞5回受賞に輝くイメルダ・スタントンが親娘であるベシカーターと初めて母娘役を一緒に演じるという点でも注目を集める。また今回の作品はイメルダ・スタントンとドミニククック演出がもう一度手を取った新作で、道徳性と自立、伝統と進歩が衝突する点で人間の選択と責任を深く照明する。

[プロット]
ビビ・ウォーレンは大学を卒業したばかりの、知性と独立心を持つ若い女性だ。彼女は母親のKitty Warrenが過去の生活のために社会的に容認されていない方法で富を呼んだことを知っています。ビビは母親の選択が道徳的に正当なものであったかどうかを尋ねる一方、それが過去の仕事ではないという現実に直面して葛藤する。自分の信念に従って生きようとする娘と、家父

腸の社会の中で生き残らなければならなかった母の価値観は衝突する。しかし、ウォーレン夫人が積み上げた莫大な富の対価は果たして何だったのだろうか？

[공연소개]\n천재 작곡가 모차르트가 생애 마지막으로 남긴 오페라 <마술.en:
[Performance introduction]
<The Magic Flute>, the last opera written by genius composer Mozart in his life, will be performed by Korea's representative National Opera. This work, which depicts the journey of a man and a woman overcoming trials and achieving love amidst the conflict between reason and emotion symbolized by night and day, has been loved by people around the world for over 200 years since its premiere in 1791. In addition to fantastic melodies, including the 'Queen of the Night' aria, the arias were performed with Korean subtitles and the lines were performed in Korean, making it easy and enjoyable for anyone to immerse themselves in. I hope the whole family can enjoy the magical feast of music presented by Mozart together.

[Plot]
This is Singsheville (a German-language opera with dialogue in the middle, like a play) that Mozart completed two months before his death.
The simple story of lovers in love and the battle between good and evil, along with Mozart's beautiful music and comical elements.
In addition, it is a work that is still loved even about 200 years after its premiere in 1791. 

In a world where the 'forces of light' ruled by Sarastro and the 'forces of darkness' ruled by the Queen of the Night are in conflict, Tamino loses his mind while being chased by a large snake, and the Queen of the Night's three maids save him. The Queen of the Night shows Tamino a portrait of her daughter Pamina and asks him to save her. The three maids give a magic flute to Tamino, who is in love with Pamina's portrait, and together with Papageno, they set off to rescue Pamina, who has been kidnapped by Sarastro. Tamino meets Pamina after many twists and turns, and they undergo Sarastro's test to confirm their love for each other and make their love come true.

[공연소개]\n\n1. <NODE>\n심재호 안무의 〈NODE〉는 인간이.en:
[Performance introduction]

1. <NODE>
〈NODE〉, choreographed by Jaeho Shim, explores the structure of the ‘group’ that humans have formed for survival, and the mechanism of ‘splitting’ that inevitably occurs within it. We form groups to connect with each other, but as the group expands, differences in standards become boundaries and create new separations. In the structure of human society, which becomes more connected and more finely divided at the same time, individuals begin to be defined by ‘where they belong.’

Rather than determining this structure, the work raises the question of whether a society complete as one is possible. Here, ‘node’ refers to a state in which each individual exists as a single point rather than a large one, and we want to explore through the body the relationships that coexist in invisible tension without being completely combined or broken.

2. 〈Walk and Waltz〉
Everyone walks. But how much do we look at the life hidden in those steps?

〈Walk and Waltz〉, choreographed by Kim Young-woong, is an experimental creation that uses ‘walking’, the most everyday human action, as the starting point of dance, with the theme of ‘swimming the rhythm of life’. This work seeks to capture the inner voices and life experiences that humans face in their lives through the everyday act of ‘walking.’ The dancer's steps extend beyond simple movement into a flow of emotions, and traces of daily life are reorganized into visual movements. The stage, which utilizes light, sound, and the texture of costumes, sensuously reveals the theme of ‘a body that walks through time.’
[공연소개]\n\n1. <NODE>\n심재호 안무의 〈NODE〉는 인간이.zh:
【性能介绍】

1. <节点>
沉在浩编排的《NODE》探讨了人类为生存而形成的“群体”的结构，以及其中不可避免地发生的“分裂”机制。我们组成团体是为了相互联系，但随着团体的扩大，标准的差异成为界限并产生新的分离。在人类社会的结构中，联系变得更加紧密，同时划分也更加精细，个人开始由“他们所属的地方”来定义。

该作品并没有确定这一结构，而是提出了一个完整的社会是否可能的问题。这里的“节点”是指每个个体作为一个点而不是一个大点存在的状态，我们想通过身体来探索那些在无形的张力中共存的关系，而不是完全结合或断裂。

2.〈散步与华尔兹〉
每个人都走路。但我们对隐藏在这些脚步中的生命有多少关注呢？

金英雄编舞的《行走与华尔兹》是以人类最日常的动作“行走”为舞蹈起点，以“游动生命的节奏”为主题的实验创作。该作品试图通过日常的“行走”行为来捕捉人类在生活中面对的内心声音和生活体验。舞者的脚步从简单的动作延伸到情感的流动，日常生活的痕迹被重新组织成视觉动作。舞台利用光、声音和服装的质感，感性地揭示了“穿越时间的身体”的主题。
[공연소개]\n\n1. <NODE>\n심재호 안무의 〈NODE〉는 인간이.ja:
【公演紹介】

1. <NODE>
シム・ジェホ振付の〈NODE〉は、人間が生存のために形成してきた「群れ」という構造と、その中で必然的に発生する「分裂」のメカニズムを探求する。私たちは互いにつながるために集団を形成しますが、群れが拡大するほど、基準の違いは境界となり、新しい分離を作り出します。より大きくつながればなるほど同時に、より細かく分かれる人間社会の構造の中で、個人は「どこに属しているか」と定義され始める。

作品はこのような構造を断定するよりも、一つに完成した社会が可能かどうかについての質問を投げる。ここで「ノード（node）」は、巨大な一つではなく、それぞれが一つの地点で存在する状態を意味し、完全に合わさっても切れないまま見えない緊張の中で共存する関係を身体で探求しようとする。

2. 〈Walk and Waltz〉
人々は皆歩く。しかし、私たちはその歩みの中に隠れた人生をどれだけ見つめていますか？

キム・ヨンウン振付の「Walk and Waltz」は「人生のリズムを遊泳する」をテーマに、人間の最も日常的な行為である「歩み」をダンスの出発点とした実験的創作だ。本作品は「歩く」という日常的な行為を通じて人間が生きて向き合う内面の声と人生の経験を捉えようとする。ダンサーの歩みは単なる動きを超えて感情の流れに広がり、日常の痕跡は視覚的な動きに再構成されます。光と音、衣装の質感を活用した舞台は「時間を歩く体」というテーマを感覚的に表わす。

[공연소개]\n\n\n재즈 음반 레코드 레이블로 대중적인 인기는 물론 예.en:
[Performance introduction]


As a jazz album record label, Blue Note has great symbolism among jazz enthusiasts in terms of not only popular popularity but also artistic achievement. Paul Cornish, a new pianist ambitiously recruited by Blue Note, is currently playing in the band of American modern saxophone virtuoso Joshua Redman, and his debut work was released by Blue Note in 2025.

 
Many media outlets commented on his debut work <You're Exaggerating!>, saying that Blue Note once again has a keen eye for finding new artists with fresh ideas, and the Financial Times evaluated the combination of Blue Note and Paul Cornish with the headline “Blue Note strikes again.” This first performance in Korea, conducted by the original members who participated in the album, consists of a trio of Joshua Crumbley (bass) and Jonathan Pinson (drums), allowing you to experience the lively performances and energy of young performers representing the current American jazz scene.


From classic bop reminiscent of bebop greats Bud Powell and Thelonious Munch to post-bop creative jazz following the lineage of modern pianists such as Jason Moran and Robert Glasper, the Paul Cornish Trio's first performance in Korea will be a performance where you can experience the essence of 21st century jazz pianism through lyrical and powerful sound, adding your own original color to Blue Note's great legacy.



[Introducing Paul Cornish]


He was a finalist at the 2023 American Piano Awards and the Herbie Hancock International Jazz Piano Competition, and won third place. He was recognized for his youthful sense and perfect skills, and has performed extensively as a session member for Joshua Redman, Louis Cole, Mark Guiliana, etc. Turning 29 this year, he already displays the maturity of a virtuoso and the agility and creativity required for jazz interplay, and is a sensational pianist selected by Blue Note.

[시놉시스]\n \n 1막 1장\n\n궁전 안. 오늘은 왕자의 20세 생.en:
[Synopsis]
 
 Act 1, Scene 1

Inside the palace. Today is the prince's 20th birthday. The prince and his friends dancing happily with the maidens of the court. At this time, the queen appears and congratulates the prince on becoming an adult and gives him a sword as a gift. After everyone leaves, Prince Siegfried, left alone, feels that some unknown force keeps leading him somewhere. 

Act 1, Scene 2

Guided by an unknown force, we arrived at a lake in the forest. The prince discovers swans on the lakeside that take on human form. Prince Siegfried falls in love with the most beautiful of them all, Princess Odette. She complains that they have been transformed into swans during the day and humans at night by a genius devil's curse, and says that to be freed from the spell of this curse, they must receive the unchanging love of one person. The prince makes a vow of love and promises to announce his marriage to her at a ball the next day, and they part ways.

Act 2, Scene 1

Palace ballroom. The prince greets the guests while waiting for Odette to arrive. The prince is urged to choose a bride among the princesses invited from Poland, Russia, Spain, Hungary, and Naples, but the prince has no intention. At that time, the devil appears with his daughter Odile. The prince runs to Odile, who resembles Odette. The devil now begins to test the prince's feelings. The prince falls for the charms of Odile the Black Swan and announces his marriage to her. At this time, darkness suddenly creeps in and a vision of Odette in despair appears. Only then does the prince realize that he has been played by a trick of fate and runs to the shore of Swan Lake.  

Act 2, Scene 2

Lakeside. Odette delivers the sad news to the swans, saying that they will live as swans forever due to the prince's betrayal. The prince came running to ask for forgiveness. However, the devil continues to interfere in order to separate him from Odette. The prince tries to fight against fate, but the devil's power is great. At that moment, when Odette tells the prince that she forgives him, a miracle occurs in which their love overcomes the evil power of the devil.

[공연소개]\n\n[사전행사 1] \n\n제32회 국내학술대회 <한국무용.en:
[Performance introduction]

[Pre-Event 1] 

32nd Domestic Academic Conference <Records of 40 years of Korean Dance Festival and discourse for the future>

As a pre-event for the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival, a domestic academic conference <Records of 40 years of the Korean Dance Festival and Discourse for the Future> will be held as a pre-event. This academic conference, held in conjunction with the Korean Dance Research Society, an affiliated organization of the Korean Dance Association, will provide an academic overview of the trends and achievements of Korean creative dance accumulated by the Korean Dance Festival over the past 40 years, reinterpret its artistic value and contemporary meaning, and research presentations to seek future directions and discourse. A forum for discussion between Korean creative dance and academia will be held on Friday, April 3 at 1 p.m. at the Multipurpose Hall of the Artist House.

[Pre-event 2] <Charm Series - Seoul Street Dance Film>

The charming city of Seoul is captured through Korean dance. Korean dancers visit the streets and spaces of Seoul, where past, present, and future coexist and whose beauty is recognized worldwide, and express them through dance. The ‘Charm Series - Streets of Seoul Dance Film’, which is attracting attention as a pre-event of the Korean Dance Festival, has so far recorded scenes where the city and dance meet, redrawing the charm of Korean dance in various places in Seoul, including Eulji-ro, Seosunla-gil, Cheonggyecheon, Jongmyosait-gil, Gwanghwamun Taepyeong-ro, Sungkyunkwan-ro, Seochon-gil, Open Songhyeon Green Plaza, Seoul Station, Haebangchon, and Nowon Gongneung Forest Road.

This dance film is expected to highlight the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival even more specially, with Park Cheol-sun, winner of the Special Jury Award in the small theater category at the 39th Korean Dance Festival in 2025, walking through Godeok Waterside Ecological Park, and Yang Ji-soo, who presented an impressive work in the small theater category, dancing through Seodaemun Prison. In addition, the Best Click Award will be awarded to works with a high number of views to recognize the choreographers' hard work in their creative activities and to help spread the works to the public and lead to meaningful results in future creative activities. The videos of Yang Ji-su on Monday, April 6th, and Cheolsun Park on Tuesday, 7th will be released at 7:30 PM through the ‘Korea Dance Association’ YouTube channel, and you can dance the streets of Seoul anytime, anywhere, regardless of location.

[Side Event] 40th Anniversary Archiving Exhibition <40 Years of Korean Dance Festival, Record of That Time> 

To commemorate the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival, an archiving exhibition <40 years of the Korean Dance Festival, a record of that time> will be held as a side event. This exhibition was planned to archive performance data accumulated from the 1st Korean Dance Festival to the 40th, share the flow and records of the changes, and systematically examine the genealogy and discourse of Korean creative dance. Through various archival materials, you can see how Korean creative dance has changed and expanded over the 40 years of the Korean Dance Festival.

This archiving exhibition, held in the main theater lobby of Arko Arts Theater, captures moments from the 40 years of the Korean Dance Festival through photos and videos to share the history and flow of Korean creative dance with the audience. The exhibition <40 years of the Korean Dance Festival, a record of that time> can be viewed for free in the main theater lobby of Arko Arts Theater from Wednesday, April 8 to Sunday, April 19.

[Awards] 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival Awards Ceremony

Among a total of 20 works presented at <2026 40th Korean Dance Festival - The Path, Trace of the Body>, the Grand Prize, Excellent Work Award, General Audience Special Award, and Best Dance Dance Performance Award will be selected in the large theater category, and the Grand Prize, Excellent Choreography Award, and Special Jury Award will be selected in the small theater category. In particular, this year, in order to recognize the choreographers who showed good choreography and work, we were able to recognize the hard work of great dancers by awarding certificates of “Dance Artist of the Year” to the eight people selected in the grand theater category. 


[Synopsis]

[Opening invitation performance] The opening invitation performance begins with a performance by the honorary chairman of the Korea Dance Association and continues with meaningful projects with the board of directors and works showing the current state of Korean creative dance.

The opening invitational performance of the Korean Dance Festival will be decorated with excellent works by many artists who have come together for the Korean Dance Festival. First, <Sounds of the Night> by honorary chairman Deok-kyung Yoon, who led the Korean Dance Association as chairman for over 10 years, will be presented. <Sounds of the Night> is a solo dance piece composed by Hwang Byeong-ki, inspired by Ahn Jung-sik's oriental painting 'Seongjaesugando (聲在樹間圖)' and premiered at the '1990 Contemporary Dance Artists Exhibition'. This is a work that expresses the dense moments, the resonance amplified in silence.

A special stage that highlights this year’s Korean Dance Festival! <Dance, the Excitement> by the Korean Dance Festival 40th Anniversary Project Team will be presented. <Dance, the Excitement>, a work that can be enjoyed by people of all ages and genders, was first performed in 1982 and is a work that seeks to complete another layer created through the unity of the audience and dancers. A coexistence structure is formed through communication between the dancers, performers, and the audience in the work, and the work is maximized through visual mise-en-scène production through the combination of object performance and modern music, theatrical elements, and modern wear of traditional costumes. For this stage of <Dance, the Excitement>, 10 dance artists, including Lim Hyun-seon, Lee Ae-hyun, and Kim Yong-cheol, who are board members of the Korea Dance Association, came together for this Korean Dance Festival. In celebration of the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival, another ‘exciting’ stage will be performed by the artists of the Korea Dance Association. 

Lastly, <Resonance and Mystery>, a work by Jeon Su-hyeon of Altimeets, which won the Best Work Award in the Grand Theater category at the 39th Korean Dance Festival in 2025, will be performed. Choreographer Jeon Soo-hyun's <Resonance and Mystery> is a work that talks about the timeless resonance and rebirth of our words, music, and art. The energy of the group dance that seems to shake the ground and the resonance through the deconstruction and recombination of Korean art are presented.  The opening performance of this Korean Dance Festival, where you can experience the history, present, and new resonance of Korean dance through three works, will convey the deep emotion of dance to the audience.

[Main Performance] 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival <The Path, Trace of the Body> A new performance by 20 choreographers!

The main performance of the Korean Dance Festival will be a competition stage for works with the theme of ‘The Path, the trace of the body’. The large theater division consists of new works presented by eight choreographers at the Arko Arts Theater's main theater, while the small theater division presents experimental and unique new works by twelve choreographers at the Cotton Hall of the Performing Arts Center of Dongduk Women's University. The Korean Dance Festival, which is held in a competition format, is positioned as a dance art festival that discovers the next generation of choreographers in the Korean dance world by selecting the best and best works, expands the representative repertoire of Korean creative dance, and leads new artistic attempts.

[Closing Invitation Performance and Awards Ceremony] A closing invitation performance where you can see works that have been in sync with the revival of Korean creative dance and award-winning works with a new sense.

You can see <Yeom> by Kang Miri Hall Dance Company, which has led the revival of Korean creative dance in the Busan area through creative work since the 1980s, at the closing invitation performance. The work <Yeom (念)> is a work that deeply interprets Seungmu, and has been evaluated as ‘an experiment on the limits of Korean traditional dance, another experiment on the overflow, and an inevitable work that must be done.’ <Yeom (念)>, which solidifies the identity and position of Korean creative dance by crossing the transformation and deconstruction of traditional dance, is expected to brighten the stage of this closing invitation performance.

Following this, <Strangers> by Dance us project Kim Hyeon-seon, winner of the Excellence Award in the Grand Theater category at the 39th Korean Dance Festival in 2025, will be performed. People who cannot mix in a certain place are expressed as strangers, and contain the message that anyone can be a stranger, so differences must be acknowledged and coexist.

At the final awards ceremony, the award-winning works that graced the 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival <The Path, Trace of the Body> will be announced. Out of a total of 20 works, the Grand Prize, Excellence Award, Audience Special Award, and Best Dance Award will be selected in the large theater category, and the Grand Prize, Excellence Award for Choreography, and Special Jury Award will be selected in the small theater category. In addition, we will be awarding ‘Dance Artist of the Year’ certificates to the eight choreographers selected in the Grand Theater category and the Best Click Award, which can be said to be the popular award of the pre-event Seoul Street Dance film, so please show your interest.

Please join us for the 2026 40th Korean Dance Festival <The Path, Trace of the Body>, which unfolds the 40 layers of time that Korean creative dance has accumulated, and the new movements that will be layered on top of them.

第32届国内学术会议<韩国舞蹈节40年的记录与未来的话语>

作为韩国舞蹈节40周年的预热活动，将举办国内学术会议<韩国舞蹈节40年的记录与对未来的讨论>作为预热活动。本次学术会议与韩国舞蹈协会下属机构韩国舞蹈研究会联合举办，将对韩国舞蹈节40年来积累的韩国创意舞蹈的趋势和成就进行学术概述，重新解读其艺术价值和当代意义，并进行研究报告以寻求未来的方向和话语。韩国创意舞蹈与学术界讨论论坛将于 4 月 3 日星期五下午 1 点举行。在艺术家之家的多功能厅。

【会前活动2】<魅力系列-首尔街舞电影>

通过韩国舞蹈捕捉首尔这座迷人的城市。韩国舞者走访过去、现在和未来共存、其美丽被全世界认可的首尔街道和空间，并通过舞蹈表达它们。作为韩国舞蹈节前期活动而备受关注的“魅力系列-首尔街头舞蹈电影”迄今为止，记录了城市与舞蹈相遇的场景，在首尔乙支路、西顺罗路、清溪川、宗庙赛街、光化门太平路、成均馆路、西村路、首尔开放松岘绿色广场等首尔各地重新描绘了韩国舞蹈的魅力。车站、解放村、芦原孔陵林道。

这部舞蹈电影预计将更加凸显韩国舞蹈节40周年，2025年第39届韩国舞蹈节小剧场部门评审团特别奖获得者朴哲善在古德水边生态公园中行走，而在小剧场部门中展现令人印象深刻的作品的梁智秀在西大门监狱中跳舞，预计将更加凸显韩国舞蹈节40周年。此外，最佳点击奖将颁发给点击量较高的作品，以表彰编舞者在创作活动中所付出的努力，并有助于作品向公众传播，在未来的创作活动中取得有意义的成果。 4月6日（星期一）杨智秀和7日（星期二）朴哲善的视频将于晚上7点30分通过“韩国舞蹈协会”YouTube频道公开，无论身在何处，都可以随时随地在首尔街头跳舞。

[周边活动]40周年档案展<韩国舞蹈节40年，那段时光的记录> 

为纪念韩国舞蹈节40周年，作为附带活动，将举办《韩国舞蹈节40年，当时的记录》档案展。本次展览旨在归档从第一届韩国舞蹈节到第40届韩国舞蹈节积累的表演数据，分享其变化的流程和记录，系统地审视韩国创意舞蹈的谱系和话语。通过各种档案资料，您可以看到韩国创意舞蹈在韩国舞蹈节40年来的变化和扩展。

此次档案展在Arko艺术剧院主剧场大厅举行，通过照片和视频捕捉韩国舞蹈节40年来的精彩瞬间，与观众分享韩国创意舞蹈的历史和流程。展览《韩国舞蹈节40年，当时的记录》可于4月8日星期三至4月19日星期日在Arko艺术剧院主剧院大厅免费观看。

[获奖情况] 2026第40届韩国舞蹈节颁奖典礼

<2026第40届韩国舞蹈节-身体的轨迹、轨迹>共20件作品中，大剧场部门将评选出大奖、优秀作品奖、普通观众特别奖、最佳舞蹈表演奖，小剧场部门将评选出大奖、优秀编舞奖、评审团特别奖。特别是，今年，为了表彰表现出良好编舞和工作的编舞家，我们向大剧院组中选出的八位舞蹈家颁发了“年度舞蹈艺术家”证书，以表彰伟大舞蹈家的辛勤工作。 


[剧情简介]

[开幕邀请表演] 开幕邀请表演以韩国舞蹈协会名誉主席的表演开始，随后与董事会进行有意义的项目以及展示韩国创意舞蹈现状的作品。

韩国舞蹈节的开幕邀请演出将由众多汇聚韩国舞蹈节的艺术家的优秀作品装点。首先将呈现担任韩国舞蹈协会会长10多年的名誉会长尹德京的《夜之声》。 《夜之声》是黄秉基以安正植的东方绘画《声在树间图》为灵感创作的独舞作品，在“1990当代舞蹈艺术家展”上首演。这是一部表达密集时刻、在沉默中放大的共鸣的作品。

今年韩国舞蹈节的亮点特别舞台！韩国舞蹈节40周年纪念项目组将呈现《舞蹈，兴奋》。 《舞动吧》是一部男女老少都可以欣赏的作品，于1982年首演，是一部力求通过观众和舞者的团结创造出另一层次的作品。作品中舞者、表演者和观众之间的交流形成共存结构，并通过物体表演与现代音乐、戏剧元素、传统服饰的现代穿着相结合的视觉布景制作将作品最大化。在《舞动吧》的舞台上，韩国舞蹈协会理事林贤善、李爱贤、金容哲等10位舞蹈艺术家齐聚一堂，共襄盛举。为庆祝韩国舞蹈节40周年，韩国舞蹈协会的艺术家们将带来另一个“激动人心”的舞台。 

最后将演出荣获2025年第39届韩国舞蹈节大剧场部门最佳作品奖的Altimeets全秀贤的作品《共鸣与神秘》。编舞家全秀贤的《共鸣与神秘》是一部讲述我们的语言、音乐和艺术的永恒共鸣和重生的作品。呈现出群舞仿佛地动山摇的能量，以及通过韩国艺术的解构和重组产生的共鸣。  本届韩国舞蹈节的开幕表演，通过三部作品感受韩国舞蹈的历史、现在和新的共鸣，将舞蹈的深沉情感传递给观众。

【主要演出】2026第40届韩国舞蹈节<身体的轨迹>20位编舞家的全新表演！

韩国舞蹈节的主要表演将以“路径，身体的痕迹”为主题的作品比赛舞台。大剧场部门由8位编舞家在Arko艺术剧院主剧场呈现的新作品组成，小剧场部门则在同德女子大学表演艺术中心的棉花厅呈现12位编舞家的实验性和独特的新作品。以竞赛形式举办的韩国舞蹈节定位为通过评选最优秀、最优秀的作品，发现韩国舞蹈界下一代编舞家、拓展韩国创意舞蹈的代表曲目、引领新的艺术尝试的舞蹈艺术节。

[闭幕邀请表演及颁奖典礼] 闭幕邀请表演，您可以看到与韩国创意舞蹈复兴同步的作品以及具有新感觉的获奖作品。

在闭幕邀请表演中，可以看到自20世纪80年代以来通过创作引领釜山地区韩国创意舞蹈复兴的姜美里霍尔舞蹈团的《Yeom》。作品《念》是对胜无进行深度诠释的作品，被评价为“对韩国传统舞蹈极限的一次实验，又是一次溢出的实验，是必然要做的作品”。通过对传统舞蹈的改造和解构，巩固了韩国创意舞蹈的身份和地位的《念》，有望为本次闭幕邀请演出的舞台增光添彩。

接下来，将演出2025年第39届韩国舞蹈节大剧场部门优秀奖得主Dance us Project金贤善的《陌生人》。不能在某个地方混在一起的人被表达为陌生人，并包含任何人都可以是陌生人的信息，因此必须承认差异并共存。

在最终颁奖典礼上，将揭晓2026年第40届韩国舞蹈节《身体的轨迹》的获奖作品。共20件作品中，大剧场类将评选出大奖、优秀奖、观众特别奖、最佳舞蹈奖，小剧场类将评选出大奖、编舞优秀奖、评审团特别奖。此外，我们还将为大剧场组选出的八位编舞者颁发“年度舞蹈艺术家”证书以及最佳点击奖，这可以说是活动前首尔街舞电影的热门奖项，请大家关注。

请与我们一起参加2026年第40届韩国舞蹈节《身体的路径、痕迹》，它将展现韩国创意舞蹈积累的40层时间，以及将在其之上分层的新动作。

第32回国内学術大会<韓国舞踊祭典40年の記録と未来のための談論>

韓国舞踊祭典40周年の事前行事として、国内学術大会「韓国舞踊祭典40年の記録と未来のための談論」が事前行事として開催されます。 （社）韓国ダンス協会の算術館である韓国舞踊研究学会とともに開催する今回の学術大会では、過去40年間韓国舞踊祭典が蓄積してきた韓国創作ダンスの流れと成果を学術的に眺望し、その芸術的価値と時代的意味を再解釈し、今後の方向と談論を模索する研究発表者韓国創作ダンスと学術が出会う談論の場を4月3日（金）午後1時、芸術家の家多目的ホールで会うことができます。

[事前イベント2] <魅力シリーズ - ソウルの街Dance Film>

魅力の都市ソウルを韓国ダンスに盛り込む。過去と現在、そして未来が共存し、世界的にその美しさを認められているソウルの街と空間を韓国舞踊家たちが訪ねて踊って表現する。韓国舞踊祭典の事前行事として注目されている「魅力シリーズ - ソウルの街Dance Film」はこれまで乙支路、ソスンラギル、チョンゲチョン、ジョンミョサイギル、光化門太平路、成均館路、ソチョンギル、開かれたソンヒョン緑地広場、ソウル駅、解放村、ノウォンゴンリョンの森都市と踊りが出会う場面を記録してきた。

今回のダンスフィルムは去る2025第39回韓国舞踊祭典の小劇場部門審査委員特別賞受賞者であるパク・チョルスンが高徳水変生態公園を、小劇場部門で印象深い作品を披露したヤン・ジスが西大門刑務所を踊りながら特別な舞踊を繰り広げた特別な舞台また、高い視聴回数を記録した作品には、ベストクリック賞を授与し、振付者たちの創作活動に対する労苦を致し、作品の大衆的拡散と今後の創作活動に意味のある成果につながるようにする予定です。 4月6日(月)ヤン・ジス、7日(火)パク・チョルスンの映像が「韓国ダンス協会」YouTubeチャンネルを通じて午後7時30分に公開され、いつでもどこでも場所にこだわらずソウルの街を踊ることができます。

【付帯行事】40周年記念アーカイブ展示＜韓国舞踊祭典40年、その時間の記録＞ 

韓国舞踊祭典40周年を記念して付帯行事アーカイブ展示<韓国舞踊祭典40年、その時間の記録>が行われます。今回の展示は、第1回韓国舞踊祭典から第40回に至るまで蓄積された公演資料をアーカイブしてその変化の流れと記録を共有し、韓国創作踊りの系譜と談論を体系的に見ることができるように企画されました。韓国舞踊祭典が歩んできた40年の時間の中で韓国創作踊りがどのように変化して拡張されてきたかを様々な記録資料を通じてお会いできます。

アルコ芸術劇場大劇場ロビーで行われる今回のアーカイブ展示は、韓国舞踊祭典40年の瞬間を写真と映像で盛り上げ、韓国創作踊りの歴史と流れを観客たちと分かち合おうとします。 ＜韓国舞踊祭典40年、その時間の記録＞ 展示は4月8日(水)から4月19日(日)までアルコ芸術劇場大劇場ロビーで無料で観覧できます。

<2026 第40回韓国舞踊祭典 - The Path、体の軌跡>で発表された合計20の作品のうち大劇場部門で最優秀、優秀作品賞と一般観客特別賞、Best Danceダンス演技賞が、小劇場部門で最優秀、優秀振付賞、審査委員特別賞が特に今年は良い振付と作品を見せた振付者のために大劇場部門に選ばれた8人を「今年のダンス作家」選定証書授与とともに素晴らしい踊り手たちの労苦も治めることができるようになった。 


[シノプシス]

[開幕招待公演]韓国ダンス協会名誉理事長の舞台を皮切りに、李写真陣が共にする重要なプロジェクトと韓国創作ダンスの現在を見せる作品まで続く開幕招待公演

韓国舞踊祭典の開幕招待公演は韓国舞踊祭典のために心を集めた多くの芸術家たちの素晴らしい作品で飾られます。まず、10年余りの理事長として韓国ダンス協会を率いた名誉理事長のユン・ドクギョンの「夜の声」が広がります。 「夜の声」は、安中式の東洋画「聲在樹間圖」にインスピレーションを受け、ファン・ビョンギ先生が作曲した曲を「1990現代ダンス作家展」で初演した独務作品です。静けさの中で増幅される響き、その密度の高い瞬間を表現する作品です。

今年の韓国舞踊祭典を輝かせる特別舞台！韓国舞踊祭典40周年プロジェクトチームの<ダンス、その命名>が繰り広げられます。男女野荘 誰でも楽しめる作品である<ダンス、その命名>は1982年初演され、観客やダンサーが合一を通じて生成されるまた別の層の完成を図る作品です。作品の中のダンサーと演奏者、そして観客たちとのコミュニケーションにより、共生構造が形成され、物事演奏と現代音楽の接木、演喜性を演劇的要素と伝統ダブルスの現代的着用で視覚的な美装セン演出で作品を最大化した作品です。今回の「ダンス、その命名」の舞台は韓国ダンス協会の理事陣であるイム・ヒョンソン、イ・エヒョン、キム・ヨンチョルなど10人のダンス芸術家たちが今回の韓国舞踊祭典のために心を集めました。韓国舞踊祭典40周年を迎え、韓国ダンス協会芸術家たちが共に作り出すもう一つの「神命」の舞台が繰り広げられる予定です。 

最後に2025第39回韓国舞踊祭典大劇場部門最優秀作品賞の栄誉を抱いた（社）舞踊団Altimeetsチョン・スヒョンの作品＜共鳴と謎＞が公演されます。チョン・スヒョン振付者の「共鳴と謎」は、私たちの言葉と音楽、芸術の時間を超えた共鳴と再誕生を語る作品です。地を鳴らすような軍務のエネルギー、韓国芸術の解体と組換えを通じた響きをプレゼントします。  3作品を通じて韓国ダンスの歴史と現在、そして新たな響きに出会える今回の韓国舞踊祭展開幕招待公演は観客の皆さんに深いダンスの感動を伝えます。

[本公演] 2026 第40回韓国舞踊祭典<The Path、体の軌跡> 20人の振付師が披露する新作舞台！

韓国舞踊祭典の本公演は〈The Path、体の軌跡〉をテーマにした作品の競演舞台で繰り広げられます。大劇場部門はアルコ芸術劇場大劇場で8人の振付師が披露する新作で構成され、小劇場部門は東徳女子大学公演芸術センターコットンホールで12人の振付家が実験的で個性ある新作を披露します。競演形式で行われる韓国舞踊祭典は、最優秀および優秀作品選定を通じて韓国舞踊界の次世代振付家を発掘し、韓国創作ダンスの代表レパートリーを拡張し、新しい芸術的試みを導く舞踊芸術祭りに位置しています。

【閉幕招待公演及び授賞式】韓国創作踊りの復興と共にした作品、そして新たな感覚の受賞作に出会える閉幕招待公演

1980年代からこれまで創作作業を続け、釜山地域の韓国創作踊りの復興を導いてきたカンミリ割舞踊団の「炎」を閉幕招待公演でお会いできます。作品「炎」は、乗務を深く解釈した作品で、「韓国伝統踊りの限界に対する実験であり、あふれのもう一つの実験であり、必ずしなければならない必然的な作業だ」という評価を聞いたことがあります。伝統踊りの変容と解体を行き来して韓国創作踊りのアイデンティティと立地を固めた「炎」は、今回の閉幕招待公演の舞台をさらに輝かせる予定です。

続いて2025年第39回韓国舞踊祭典大劇場部門優秀作品賞受賞作であるDance us projectキム・ヒョンソンの<異邦人たち>が公演される。どんなところに混ざらないのかを異邦人として表現し、誰もが異邦人になることができるので、その違いを認めて共存しなければならないというメッセージが含まれています。

最後に行われる授賞式では、2026第40回韓国舞踊祭典「The Path、体の軌跡」を輝かせた受賞作品を発表します。全20作品のうち大劇場部門で最優秀、優秀作品賞と観客特別賞、そしてBest Danceダンス演技賞が、小劇場部門で最優秀、優秀振付賞、審査委員特別賞が選ばれます。また、大劇場部門に選ばれた8人の振付家たちに授与される「今年のダンス作家」選定証書と事前行事ソウルの街Dance filmの人気賞といえるベストClick賞まで授与される予定なので、多くの関心お願いします。

韓国創作踊りが積み重ねてきた四十重の時間、そしてその上に重なる新たなジェスチャーが繰り広げられる今回の2026第40回韓国舞踊祭典<The Path, 体の軌跡>を一緒にしてください。

[공연소개]\n‘깊은 음악성과 독보적인 존재감’으로 세계 무대의 주목을.en:
[Performance introduction]
Cellist Kian Soltani, who has been attracting attention on the world stage for his ‘deep musicality and unique presence,’ and pianist Jaehong Park, who has rapidly expanded his presence through international competitions, will present a duo recital.
Soltani, resident artist of the Iceland Symphony Orchestra, has been described as a “remarkable cellist” by The Times and “perfection itself” by Gramophone. As an exclusive artist for Deutsche Grammophon, he has performed with world-class orchestras such as the Berlin Staatskapelle, Munich Philharmonic, and NHK Symphony.
Jaehong Park gained international fame by winning the 2021 Ferruccio Busoni International Piano Competition with four special awards, and has proven his musical capabilities by winning the Cleveland International Young Artist Piano Competition and the Gina Bakauer Competition.
On this stage, the program continues with Reza Valli, Schubert, and Rachmaninoff, naturally revealing each person's musical roots and interpretations. Soltani's cello, with its deep lyricism and sophisticated technique, and Jaehong Park's piano, with its wide tone and solid structure, form a dense ensemble in close harmony. This duo recital, completed by the combination of experience accumulated on the international stage and mature musicianship, will be a time to present the depth of sincere chamber music beyond glamour.

[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.en:
[Performance introduction]

Since the ‘King Of Popera - King of Popera’ recital commemorating the 25th anniversary of his debut, which was grandly held at the Sejong Center for the Performing Arts in Seoul in September 2023, the ‘original popera star’ Lim Hyung-joo (40, Distinguished Professor of Vocal Music at Rome City University of the Arts) is holding a paid recital in Seoul for the first time in three years!

 
Became the first Korean to receive the UN Peace Medal, completely conquered the three major halls of Carnegie Hall in the U.S. with a solo performance, signed an exclusive album distribution contract with one of the world's top four record labels, received Japan's NHK's 'Red and White Song Concert' and both the U.S. Obama & Trump Presidential Awards, was a voting member and judge of the U.S. Grammy Award, had a private audience and performance with Pope Francis, was awarded the title of FRSA for life by the Royal Society of Arts and was awarded the title of FRSA by the Royal Society of Korea, received a commendation from the President of the Republic of Korea and is the youngest recipient of the National Merit in history. Lim Hyeong-ju, a true popera legend born in Korea, including the Dongbaekjang Medal, will hold a New Year's recital with the subtitle 'Popera Sensation!' at Yeongsan Art Hall in Yeouido, Seoul at 7:30 pm on March 20th.

 
In this performance, Lim Hyeong-ju will present to the audience the elegant, gorgeous, lyrical and grand 'essence of popera', including 'Become a Thousand Winds' and 'I Hope You Are Happy (KBS Cheerful Girl Chunhyang OST)', classical music, pop music, musicals, pop songs, and even special 7080 dance songs, with the fantastic accompaniment of the Korean National Philharmonic Ensemble, of which he has served as music director for a long time.

 
There is no doubt that a lot of public attention will be paid to his beautiful and affectionate songs that are closer to his friendly appearance that removes his mysticism, such as his recent appearances in EBS's <Seo Jang-hoon's Millionaire Next Door>, KBS's <100 People's Emotional Show: The Signature>, Channel A's <Table for Four>, and TV Chosun's <Dad and Me>.

[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.zh:
【性能介绍】

继2023年9月在首尔世宗文化中心隆重举办“King Of Popera - King of Popera”出道25周年纪念演奏会之后，“流行音乐原创明星”林亨柱（40岁，罗马城市艺术大学声乐特聘教授）时隔3年再次在首尔举办付费演奏会！

 
成为第一个获得联合国和平奖章的韩国人，以个人表演彻底征服美国卡内基音乐厅三大礼堂，与世界四大唱片公司之一签订独家专辑发行合同，获得日本NHK“红白歌音乐会”和美国奥巴马和特朗普总统双项奖，是美国格莱美奖的投票成员和评委，与教皇弗朗西斯进行私人观众和表演，被授予称号被英国皇家艺术学会授予终身FRSA称号，并被韩国皇家学会授予FRSA称号，受到大韩民国总统的嘉奖，是历史上最年轻的国家功绩获得者。荣获冬百将勋章的韩国真正的波佩拉传奇人物林亨柱将举办题为“波佩拉轰动！”的新年独奏会。 3月20日晚上7点30分在首尔汝矣岛灵山艺术厅举行。

 
在本次演出中，林亨柱将在他担任过的韩国国家爱乐乐团的精彩伴奏下，为观众呈现优雅、华丽、抒情、宏大的“流行音乐精髓”，包括《成为千风》、《希望你幸福（KBS开朗少女春香OST）》、古典音乐、流行音乐、音乐剧、流行歌曲，甚至特别的7080舞曲。长期担任音乐总监。

 
毫无疑问，他最近出演的EBS《徐长勋的邻家百万富翁》、KBS《百人情感秀：签名》、Channel A《四人桌》、朝鲜电视台《爸爸和我》等，优美而深情的歌曲，更接近他消除了神秘感的友善外表，将受到很多公众的关注。

[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.ja:
【公演紹介】

去る2023年9月、ソウル世宗文化会館大劇場で盛大に繰り広げられた「デビュー25周年記念独創会<King Of Popera - キング・オブ・ポップフェラ>」以後「援助ポップフェラスター」イム・ヒョンジュ(40、ローマ市立芸術大学声楽科席座)

 
韓国人初のUN平和メダル受賞、米国カーネギーホール3大ホールソロ公演で完全征服、世界4大レコード会社独占アルバム流通契約締結、日本NHK「紅白歌合戦」、米国オバマ＆トランプ大統領賞すべて受賞、米国グラミー賞投票人団兼審査委員、イギリス王立芸術学会終身石学会員およびイギリス王室FRSA公称授与、大韓民国大統領表彰および歴代最年少国民勲章椿章勲訓などまさに韓国が生んだポップフェラの伝説イム・ヒョンジュが来る3月20日夕方7時30分センセーション - ポップフェラの感動)!」という副題をつけて新春独創会を持つ。

 
今回の公演でイム・ヒョンジュは自身が長い間音楽監督として在職しているコリアンナショナルフィルハーモニックアンサンブルの幻想的な伴奏で「千の風になって」、「幸せになることを願う（KBS快楽春香OST）」をはじめ、クラシック、ポップ、ミュージカル、歌曲0叙情的でありながらも壮大な「ポップフェラの真髄」を観客に披露する予定だ。

[공연소개]\n\n지금 우리 시대에 기대하는 환상은 무엇일까요? \n우리.en:
[Performance introduction]

What is the fantasy we look forward to in our times? 
The world of memories and emotions we remember may not fit the current era. 
For those of you who are concerned about reality and ideals rather than expecting a magical coincidence, A TRIP TO THE MOON provides a brief emotional journey and time to reflect on yourself in the process.
[공연소개]\n\n지금 우리 시대에 기대하는 환상은 무엇일까요? \n우리.zh:
【性能介绍】

我们这个时代所期待的幻想是什么？ 
我们记忆中的记忆和情感世界可能不适合当今时代。 
对于那些关心现实和理想而不是期待神奇巧合的人来说，《月球之旅》提供了一段短暂的情感之旅，并让他们有时间在这个过程中反思自己。
[공연소개]\n\n지금 우리 시대에 기대하는 환상은 무엇일까요? \n우리.ja:
【公演紹介】

今、私たちの時代に期待する幻想は何でしょうか？ 
私たちが覚えていた思い出と感性の世界は今の時代には合わないかもしれません。 
魔法のような偶然への期待よりも現実と理想に悩んでいる皆さんに、A TRIP TO THE MOONはしばらく感性の旅をその過程で今に振り返る時間を提供します。

[Program]

1) Overture for Youth (composed by Jeongho Lee)
2) Daegeum Concerto ‘From Within’ (composed by Jeong-ho Lee, performed by Daegeum Concerto, Professor Geun-hwa Ryu of Kyungpook National University)

※ UNESCO’s virtue of emphasizing the modernization of tradition and the next generation (youth) is visualized through original songs and youth collaborations.

※ UNESCO’s virtue of emphasizing the modernization of tradition and the next generation (youth) is visualized through original songs and youth collaborations.
6) Korean traditional music orchestra ‘Beat-and-Deo-ga’ (collaborating singer Seon-myeong Lee) 
* Program may be subject to change.
[프로그램]\n\n1) 청년을 위한 서곡(이정호 작곡)\n2) 대금협주곡.zh:
[节目内容]

1) 青春序曲（李正浩作曲）
2) 大琴协奏曲《From Within》（李正浩作曲，庆北大学柳根华教授大琴协奏曲演奏）
3) 以Changbu Tarying为主题的Piri协奏曲（由Beom-Hoon Park作曲，由长笛合作者、釜山大学Seong-Jun Kim教授演奏）
※ 以韩国民歌为基础的长笛协奏曲。 2012年，《阿里郎》被列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
4）《火之谷》（李昌熙作曲，新民乐协会演奏（6人））
※ 联合国教科文组织强调传统现代化和下一代（青年）的美德通过原创歌曲和青年合作得以体现。
5) 盘古特与韩国传统管弦乐团“Shinmodum”（由 Beomhoon Park 作曲，由 Yeonhee Performer Group Cheorat 演奏（6 人））
※ 联合国教科文组织强调传统现代化和下一代（青年）的美德通过原创歌曲和青年合作得以体现。
6) 韩国传统乐团“Beat-and-Deo-ga”（合作歌手李宣明） 
* 计划可能会发生变化。
[프로그램]\n\n1) 청년을 위한 서곡(이정호 작곡)\n2) 대금협주곡.ja:
[プログラム]

1) 青年のための西曲（イ・ジョンホ作曲）
2）代金協奏曲「内面から」（イ・ジョンホ作曲、代金協演リュ・グンファ慶北大教授）
3）チャンブタリョン主題による笛協奏曲（パク・ボムフン作曲、笛協演キム・ソンジュン釜山大学教授）
※韓国民謡を素材としたフルート協奏曲。 「アリラン」が2012年ユネスコ人類無形文化遺産代表リストに登載
4)火の渓谷(イ・チャンヒ作曲、共演新民俗楽会ボディ(6人))
※ 伝統の現代化と後続世代（青年）を重視するユネスコの徳を創作曲と青年協演陣に可視化

※ 伝統の現代化と後続世代（青年）を重視するユネスコの徳を創作曲と青年協演陣に可視化
6) 国楽館弦楽「麺ダーガ」

[Performance introduction]
2026 Impromptu Sympathy Theater Spring Regular Performance (Playback Theater) - ‘GRAY’

We all have a story.
